article_content: A 33-year-old man who once weighed a staggering 962 pounds has undergone a remarkable transformation over the past five years, reducing his weight to just 205 pounds—less than a quarter of his former size. Robert Walls, an aspiring chef and line cook in Lawrence, Kansas, was once confined to a nursing home among elderly patients, facing a life-threatening condition. He credits his survival to gastric bypass surgery in 2008, which he pursued after losing 100 pounds to qualify. 'Gastric bypass is not a magic fix,' Walls told LJWorld.com. 'Just because you have weight-loss surgery doesn't mean you can keep living the same way.' Following his surgery, Walls also underwent additional procedures to remove hundreds of pounds of excess skin—a common consequence after massive weight loss. He has spent countless hours exercising at the gym and playing basketball to maintain his progress, emphasizing that surgery alone was not enough. When Walls entered the five-hour bypass procedure in September 2008, he weighed 844 pounds. Within his first month, he had already lost 100 pounds. After losing roughly 400 pounds, doctors determined he needed surgery to address the loose, hanging skin that remained. Over 90% of patients who undergo significant weight loss experience similar issues due to lost skin elasticity. Walls struggled with isolation and shame during his heaviest years. He became homeless, cut ties with family for years, and spent long periods alone in nursing homes—yet used that time to earn bachelor’s degrees in hotel and restaurant management, culinary arts, and graphic design. Two nurses, Ron Goodman and Paige Whitney, inspired him to pursue surgery. 'They told me I was too young to be in a nursing home,' Walls recalled. He now dedicates his life to mentoring teens and adults struggling with obesity, warning them against the false promises of reality TV shows like 'The Biggest Loser.' 'Those people have celebrity trainers, dietitians, and endless support,' he said. 'They lose weight on camera—and gain it all back within months. That’s not real life.' Walls still battles body image issues. 'Sometimes I look in the mirror and think, “I look sick,”' he admitted. 'It’s a daily adjustment—but I’m getting better at accepting myself.' Though featured on Lifetime, A&E, and the Food Network, he refuses to glamorize his journey. 'I won’t sugarcoat it. I was so heavy I couldn’t fit behind the wheel of a car. I want people to hear the truth.'

Robert Walls, nadšený šéfkuhár a pracovník na linke v Lawrence, Kansas, bol kedysi zavretý v starostlivostnom dome medzi staršími pacientmi, ktorí čakali na smrť. Svoje prežitie pripisuje operácii gastrointestinálneho bypassu z roku 2008, ktorú si dal vykonať po stratení 45 kg, aby splnil podmienky. 'Gastrointestinálny bypass nie je kúzelné riešenie,' povedal Walls novinám LJWorld.com. 'Len preto, že máte operáciu na stratu hmotnosti, neznamená to, že môžete pokračovať v živote tak, ako ste ho žili.' Po operácii sa Walls musel podrobiť ďalším zákrokom na odstránenie stoviek libier prepúšťanej kože, čo je bežný následok po masívnej strate hmotnosti. Od operácie trávi neuväziteľné množstvo hodín na cvičení v posilňovni a na basketbalovom ihrisku, zdôrazňujúc, že samotná operácia nebola dostatočná. Keď v septembri 2008 podstúpil päťhodinovú operáciu bypassu, vážil 383 kg. Už po prvom mesiaci stratil 45 kg. Po stratení približne 180 kg sa lekári rozhodli, že potrebuje ďalšiu operáciu na odstránenie voľnej, visiacej kože. Viac ako 90 % pacientov, ktorí podstúpia významnú stratu hmotnosti, zažíva podobné problémy kvôli strate pružnosti kože. Počas svojich najťažších rokov Walls trpel izoláciou a hanbou. Stal sa bezdomovcom, prerušil kontakt s rodinou po rokoch a strávil dlhé obdobia sám v starostlivostných domoch — no využil tento čas na získanie bakalárskeho titulu z hotelovej a reštauračnej managementu, kuchárstva a grafického dizajnu. Dve sestry, Ron Goodman a Paige Whitney, ho inšpirovali k operácii. 'Povedali mi, že som príliš mladý na to, aby som bol v starostlivostnom dome,' pripomína Walls. Teraz sa venuje mentoringu mladistvých a dospelých trpiacich obezitou a varuje ich pred falošnými sľubmi reality show ako 'The Biggest Loser'. 'Ti ľudia majú celebritné trenéry, dietológov a neustálu podporu,' povedal. 'Stratia hmotnosť na televízii — a po mesiacoch si ju znovu pridajú. To nie je reálny život.' Walls stále bojuje s problémami s obrazom tela. 'Niektoré dni sa pozriem do zrkadla a myslím si: „Vyzeral som chorý“,' priznal. 'Je to denný výzva — ale postupne sa učím akceptovať seba.' Aj keď bol prezentovaný na Lifetime, A&E a Food Network, odmieta romantizovať svoju cestu. 'Nebudem to znehodnocovať. Bol som taký veľký, že som sa nezmestil za volant auta. Chcem, aby ľudia počuli pravdu.'

article_content: For the first time, militants from the Islamic State launched an assault on the Syrian border town of Kobane, reportedly crossing into the area from Turkish territory — a development suggesting the town is now completely surrounded. According to Kurdish officials, the attack began when a suicide bomber detonated an armored vehicle near the border, killing at least 30 fighters. Nawaf Khalil of the Kurdish Democratic Union Party noted that while IS previously attacked from three directions, today’s strike came from all four sides. The Turkish government firmly denied these allegations, insisting the vehicle never entered Kobane via Turkish soil. In a statement, Ankara emphasized that no official had claimed otherwise and that border security forces had taken all required precautions. However, local activists like Mustafa Bali reported seeing IS fighters stationed in grain silos just across the border in Turkey, using them as launch points for assaults on Kobane’s crossing points. Witnesses described thick plumes of black smoke rising over the town, accompanied by the roar of heavy gunfire and armored vehicles moving along the frontier. The Britain-based Syrian Observatory for Human Rights confirmed that IS had deployed tanks southwest of Kobane in an effort to strengthen their position. Meanwhile, the U.S.-led coalition carried out airstrikes east of the town on Saturday morning, targeting militant positions. Since mid-September, IS has steadily gained ground around Kobane, seizing nearby villages and parts of the town itself. But since late October, the tide has begun to shift: dozens of well-equipped Iraqi Peshmerga fighters joined Syrian Kurds in repelling the advance. Over the past two months, hundreds of combatants have died on both sides. The latest round of fighting alone claimed at least eight Kurdish fighters and 17 IS militants, according to the Observatory.

Podľa kurdských úradníkov sa útok začal, keď samovražedný útočník vypálil pancierované vozidlo blízko hranice, čím zabil aspoň 30 bojovníkov. Nawaf Khalil z Kurdskej demokratickej únie strany poznamenal, že IS predtým útočil zo troch smerov, ale dnes sa útok uskutočnil zo všetkých štyroch strán. Turecká vláda tieto obvinenia kategoricky zamietla, tvrdiac, že vozidlo nikdy neprešlo do Kobané cez turecké územie. V vyhlásení Ankara zdôraznila, že žiadny úradník neuviedol opak a hranicné bezpečnostné sily prijali všetky nevyhnutné opatrenia. Avšak miestni aktívisti ako Mustafa Bali hlásili, že videli bojovníkov IS stojacich v obilných silách práve po druhej strane hranice v Turecku, kde ich používajú ako východiskové body pre útoky na hraničný priechod Kobané. Svedkovia popísali husté čierne dymové stĺpy stúpajúce nad mestom, sprevádzané hukotom ťažkého strieľania a pancierovanými vozidlami, ktoré sa pohybovali pozdĺž hranice. Britská Sýrska observatórium ľudských práv potvrdilo, že IS zavedlo tanky na juhozápad od Kobané, aby posilnilo svoju pozíciu. Zároveň koalícia vedená Spojenými štátmi vykonala nálety na východ od mesta v sobotu ráno, cieľom boli bojovnícke pozície. Od polovice septembra IS postupne získaval územie okolo Kobané, obsadzoval okolité dediny a časti mesta. Ale od konca októbra sa situácia začala meniť: desiatky dobre vybavených irackých pešmerg sa pridali ku syrským Kurdom, aby odrazili ofenzívu. Počas posledných dvoch mesiacov zahynulo stovky bojovníkov na oboch stranách. Najnovší boj zabil aspoň osem kurdských bojovníkov a 17 bojovníkov IS, podľa Observatória.

article_content: BBC bosses have spent £48,000 on a couch and a fake television set at the corporation's new headquarters in Media City, Salford, Greater Manchester. The replica — modeled after the BBC Breakfast set — is part of the public tour and designed to give visitors a hands-on experience. A BBC spokesperson told the Sun: 'It is based on the BBC Breakfast set. The sofa and the rest of the £48,000 mock studio allow visitors a hands-on experience.' However, the decision has drawn criticism. Dia Chakravarty, Political Director at the TaxPayers' Alliance, said: 'The BBC must focus on ensuring value for licence fee-payers' money. Hard-pressed families expect their cash to be spent on quality programming and will rightly be frustrated at so much being spent on a sofa.' The BBC responded that public tours in northern England have attracted nearly 50,000 visitors in just over two years, with revenues exceeding the cost of the set. The exhibit is designed to 'give visitors a chance to try out their presenting skills.' According to the BBC website, the interactive studio lets visitors 'have a go at making their own news and weather bulletin.' Tour guides promise to 'entertain and surprise you as you walk in the footsteps of your favourite stars' and offer insights into how TV and radio production works.

Ťažko si žijúce rodiny očakávajú, že ich peniaze budú vynakladané na kvalitné programy, a budú správne rozčúlené tým, že toľko peňazí bolo minutých na gauč.' BBC odpovedala, že verejné prehliadky na severe Anglicka priviedli takmer 50 000 návštevníkov za menej ako dva roky, pričom príjmy prevyšujú náklady na sadu. Vodiči prehliadky sľubujú, že 'vás zábavnou a prekvapivou cestou zavedú krok za krokom v stopách vašich obľúbených hviezd' a poskytnú fascinujúci pohľad na fungovanie televízie a rádia.

article_content: In a devastating wave of violence across Pakistan, five female health workers delivering life-saving polio vaccines were shot dead by armed assailants. Two of the women were killed inside homes while administering drops to young children; others died while moving between households. The attacks, occurring within 15 minutes across distant neighborhoods in Karachi and one in a village near Peshawar, were carried out using 9mm pistols. Among the victims were two teenagers—aged 18 and 19—and two women in their 40s. Their deaths have forced authorities to pause a critical three-day national immunization drive funded by UNICEF, aimed at protecting millions of children under five from polio—a disease that can cause permanent paralysis or death, especially in unsanitary conditions. The Taliban have long opposed the campaign, alleging it is a front for U.S. intelligence operations. This suspicion traces back to 2011, when a Pakistani doctor collaborated with the CIA under the guise of a vaccination program to locate Osama bin Laden. That betrayal deeply damaged public trust, particularly in Pashtun communities where many militants are believed to hide. Local religious figures continue to spread false claims that the vaccine causes sterilization and aims to reduce the Muslim population. Despite the terror, officials refuse to surrender. Janbaz Afridi, a senior health official in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, emphasized that the killings won’t halt progress. 'We are determined to eliminate polio despite all odds,' he said. Families of the slain workers—like Rukhsana Bibi, mourning her daughter Madiha, and Amtiaz Khan, grieving his sister Nasima—have become symbols of both loss and resilience. While the government has suspended operations in Karachi, efforts are planned to resume in high-risk zones, including tribal areas bordering Afghanistan. The tragedy underscores not only the dangers faced by frontline health workers but also how misinformation and past abuses continue to endanger public health.

Dve z nich boli zastrelené vo vnútri domov, kým podávali lieky malým deťom; ostatné zahynuli, keď sa pohybovali medzi domami. Útoky, ktoré sa odohrali v priebehu 15 minút v rôznych častiach Karáči a jednom v obci blízko Peshawaru, boli vykonané pomocou pištolí kalibru 9 mm. Medzi obetami boli dve dievčatá vo veku 18 a 19 rokov a ďalšie dve ženy vo veku 40 rokov. Ich smrť nútila úradníkov pozastaviť kritický trojdňový národný očkovací program financovaný UNICEF, ktorý mal za cieľ chrániť milióny detí mladších ako päť rokov pred poliomyelitídou — chorobou, ktorá môže spôsobiť trvalú paralýzu alebo úmrtie, najmä v nečistých podmienkach. Taliban dlhodobo odmietajú túto kampani a tvrdia, že je to prekrývka pre americké tajné služby. Tento podozrenie sa datuje k roku 2011, keď pakistanský lekár spolupracoval s CIA pod pokrovkou očkovacej kampane, aby pomohol nájsť Usámu bin Ládina. Táto zrada hlboko poškodila verejnú dôveru, najmä v pashtúnskych komunitách, kde sa predpokladá, že sa skrýva mnoho militantov. Miestni náboženskí vodcovia ďalej šíria falošné tvrdenia, že očkovanie spôsobuje neplodnosť a má za cieľ znížiť počet mešťanov. Napriek strašnosti úradníci nechcú kapitulovať. Janbaz Afridi, vysoký zdravotný úradník v provincii Chajbar-Pachtuňsko, zdôraznil, že tieto zabitia nezastavia pokrok. 'Sme rozhodnutí zlikvidovať polio napriek všetkým prekážkam,' povedal. Rodiny zabitých pracovníčok — ako Rukhsana Bibi, ktorá žiaľuje svoju dcéru Madihu, a Amtiaz Khan, ktorý žiaľuje svoju sestru Nasimu — sa stali symbolmi straty aj odhodlania. Aj keď vláda pozastavila operácie v Karáči, plánuje sa ich obnoviť v rizikových oblastiach vrátane pohraničných kmeňových regiónov v Afganistane. Tragédia zdôrazňuje nie len nebezpečenstvo, ktorému sú vystavené zdravotnícke pracovníčky na prednej línii, ale aj to, ako dezinformácia a minulé zneužitia stále ohrozujú verejné zdravie.

article_content: Jurgen Klopp insists he is a better manager now than he was two years ago, when Borussia Dortmund last won the Bundesliga. Despite the club sitting at the bottom of the league, Klopp sees no reason to step down and remains confident he can turn their fortunes around this season. The 46-year-old has been linked with a potential move to Arsenal as Arsene Wenger’s successor and has admitted he would be open to offers from the Premier League. However, under mounting pressure, Klopp has no intention of leaving anytime soon. 'I'm not one for quitting. I am all or nothing,' he said. 'As long as Dortmund wants that, I will continue in that way. I'm a fighter—and I'm a better coach than in 2012, even if the table doesn't show it.' Dortmund have earned just 11 points from 13 league matches, slipping to last place after a 2-0 defeat at Eintracht Frankfurt on Sunday. Klopp comforted striker Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang after the match, while some traveling fans expressed their discontent with whistles. 'I totally understand the criticism—that’s human. The whistles? I get it. They’re completely normal,' Klopp said. 'But anyone who whistles should ask themselves: Does it help?' Still, he added, 'The situation doesn’t feel catastrophic to me.' He then joked, 'If you want to succeed, you have one option: become a Bayern fan.' Dortmund faced their fans in silence after the final whistle—marking their eighth league loss of the season. Klopp appeared visibly distraught, as pressure mounts on him and the squad. Klopp has every right to demand patience: he led Dortmund to back-to-back Bundesliga titles in 2011 and 2012, and guided them to the 2013 Champions League final. Their next crucial match is against Hoffenheim at the Signal Iduna Park on Friday night.
translated_content: Jurgen Klopp trvá na tom, že je teraz lepším trénerom ako pred dvoma rokmi, keď Borussia Dortmund naposledy vyhrala Bundesligu. Aj napriek tomu, že klub sedí na poslednom mieste, Klopp nevidí dôvod odísť a stále verí, že vie obrátiť ich šťastie v tejto sezóne. 46-ročný tréner bol prepojený s potenciálnym presunom do Arsenalu ako nástupca Arséna Wengera a priznal, že by bol otvorený ponukám z Premier League. Avšak pod rastúcim tlakom nemá žiadne zámery opustiť klub v blízkej budúcnosti. 'Nie som typ, ktorý sa vzdáva. Som celkom alebo nič,' povedal. 'Ak to Dortmund chce, budem pokračovať takto. Som bojovník — a som lepším trénerom ako v roku 2012, aj keď to tabuľka neukazuje.' Dortmund získali len 11 bodov zo 13 ligových zápasov a spadli na posledné miesto po prehre 2:0 na štadióne Eintracht Frankfurt v nedeľu. Klopp uklidňoval útočníka Pierre-Emericka Aubameyanga po zápase, zatiaľ čo niektorí cestujúci fanúšikovia vyjadrovali svoju nespokojnosť hvízdaním. 'Úplne rozumiem kritike — to je ľudské. Hvízdy? Chápem. Sú úplne normálne,' povedal Klopp. 'Ale každý, kto hvízda, by si mal položiť otázku: Pomáha to?' Pridal však: 'Situačne sa mi nezdá katastrofálna.' Potom sa usmial: 'Ak chcete dosiahnuť úspech, máte jedinú možnosť: stať sa fanúšikom Bayernu.' Dortmund sa po finalnom píšťale stretli s vlastnými fanúšikmi v tichosti — čo bolo ich ôsmou porážkou v lige. Klopp vyzeral viditeľne znepokojený, keď sa tlak na neho a tím zvyšuje. Klopp má právo požadovať trpezlivosť: viedol Dortmund k dvom po sebe idúcim titulom v Bundeslige v rokoch 2011 a 2012 a priviedol ich do finále Ligy majstrov v roku 2013. Ich ďalší kľúčový zápas je proti Hoffenheimu na Signal Iduna Park vo štvrtok večer.

article_content: On the second day of the third Test in Mumbai, India exploded offensively, amassing 443 for 1 in just 79 overs, thanks largely to Virender Sehwag’s blistering innings of 284 — the second-quickest double century in Test history. Sehwag reached his landmark off just 239 balls, becoming the first Indian to notch six Test double-centuries and closing in on becoming the first player ever to score three triple centuries in Tests. His explosive knock included 40 boundaries and seven sixes, with much of the damage directed at Sri Lanka’s legendary off-spinner Muttiah Muralitharan, who went wicketless and conceded 119 runs in 20 overs. Sri Lanka, who began the day at 366 for 8, collapsed dramatically after Angelo Mathews was controversially run out for 99 — replays confirmed his bat hovered just above the crease as the bails were dislodged by a sharp throw from Sachin Tendulkar. Young left-arm spinner Pragyan Ojha finished the job with three wickets, helping bowl Sri Lanka out for 393. In reply, opener Murali Vijay, playing only his second Test, struck 87 before falling lbw to Rangana Herath. Rahul Dravid then anchored the innings with a composed 62, giving Sehwag the strike to unleash his fury. Sehwag himself admitted he played more carefully early on to avoid repeating past mistakes, then seized control once the new ball lost its shine. Meanwhile, in Wellington, Pakistan limped to 161 for 6 on a rain-affected opening day of their Test against New Zealand. Daryl Tuffey returned from a five-year layoff to claim two wickets, while captain Daniel Vettori spun a web with 3 for 42, dismissing key batsmen Imran Farhat, Salman Butt, and Mohammad Yousuf in quick succession. On a separate note, Australian fast bowler Brett Lee underwent successful elbow surgery to repair a damaged ligament, a procedure aimed at extending his career. The 33-year-old, who missed the recent Ashes series, is unlikely to return until at least March, raising questions about his future in international cricket.
translated_content: Na druhý deň tretieho Testu v MumBai sa indická tíma vysoko preukázala, dosiahla 443 za 1 v iba 79 overs, hlavne vďaka Virenderovi Sehwagovi, ktorý zaznamenal ohromujúci výkon 284 — druhý najrýchlejší dvojnásobný stovka v histórii Testov. Sehwag dosiahol svoj milník na iba 239 loptách, stal sa prvým Indom, ktorý dosiahol šesť dvojnásobných stoviek v Testoch, a blíži sa k tomu, aby sa stal prvým hráčom, ktorý dosiahne tri trojnásobné stovky v Testoch. Jeho agresívny výkon zahŕňal 40 hraníc a sedem šiestok, pričom veľká časť poškodenia bola smerovaná na legendárneho off-spinera Srí Lanky Muttiah Muralitharana, ktorý nezískal žiadne výhry a stratil 119 bodov za 20 overs. article_content: A sarcastic social media post pretending to be a prayer has sparked controversy across the U.S. and Iran, targeting world leaders including Barack Obama, New Jersey Governor Chris Christie, and Iran’s Mahmoud Ahmadinejad. The meme-style message lists beloved celebrities who passed away—like Michael Jackson, Patrick Swayze, and Farrah Fawcett—before adding, 'My favorite president is Barack Obama. Amen.' Since its April 10 debut on Facebook, the post has garnered over 600,000 likes. The anonymous author insists it’s meant as dark humor to express political frustration, not a literal wish for harm. Similar versions surfaced in New Jersey, where a school district memo replaced Obama with Christie, prompting an apology from the teachers’ union. In Iran, hackers posted a chilling variant on Ahmadinejad’s website, referencing the death of Neda Agha-Soltan, a young woman fatally shot during 2009 protests. Facebook declined to remove the content, stating it doesn’t cross into direct threats or hate speech under its guidelines, even if many find it offensive. The company emphasizes community reporting and human review teams to manage borderline content, calling its moderation system highly self-correcting.

Tento memesový text uvádza obľúbených celebrit, ktorí zomreli – ako Michael Jackson, Patrick Swayze a Farrah Fawcett – a potom pripočítava: 'Moje obľúbeného prezidenta je Barack Obama. Amen.' article_content:
Captain Lary Batiste, a Black supervisor with the Houston Fire Department, has been placed on administrative leave following the publication of inflammatory messages on his personal Facebook page. The posts, made after his vehicle was vandalized near his home, targeted Hispanic teenage boys, threatening lethal consequences if they were found responsible. Batiste wrote, 'I will make them deceased if I find them,' and added that parents who fail to monitor their children’s whereabouts on school nights deserve to bury their kids unnecessarily. He dismissed the 'hands up, don't shoot' protest slogan, declaring it ineffective against him, and concluded with an unfiltered outburst: 'I AM PISSED OFF TO THE HIGHEST OF PISSTIVITY!!!'

The Houston Fire Department confirmed it is investigating the matter and expects to conclude the review within a few weeks. Batiste has been temporarily removed from field duties pending the outcome. This is not the first time the department has faced scrutiny over racially insensitive conduct by its personnel. In June, firefighter Kerry Williams was reassigned after posting a Facebook comment seeking a 'drunk Mexican' while searching for a drowned 47-year-old man in Lake Houston.

These incidents occur amid heightened national awareness around racial injustice. The phrase 'hands up, don't shoot' became a rallying cry after eyewitnesses claimed Michael Brown, an unarmed 18-year-old, had his hands raised when he was fatally shot by Officer Darren Wilson in Ferguson, Missouri, in August 2014. The subsequent failure to indict Wilson ignited nationwide protests. Since then, athletes, politicians, and activists—including members of the St. Louis Rams and Rep. Hakeem Jeffries—have publicly adopted the gesture to honor Brown and condemn police violence.

article_content: (CNN) — There is little about the horror that unfolded in a dark Aurora, Colorado, movie theater that Eugene Han and Kirstin Davis can forget: the sound of gunfire, the screams, the chaos that followed as accused gunman James Holmes opened fire in a rampage that left 12 people dead and 58 wounded — including Han and Davis. One year later, the couple is reclaiming that day, replacing the fear they felt with the love they have for each other, as they marry on Saturday — exactly one year after the shooting. "My thought process was that everyone has a date that means something special to them," Han said Thursday on CNN's Piers Morgan Live. "For us, it was a night of terror. So we wanted to transform it — make it our own." Surviving that night was nearly impossible. On July 20, 2012, Han and Davis were on a date to see the midnight screening of 'The Dark Knight Rises.' They had known each other since elementary school, but now, in the theater, they were a young couple enjoying their connection. Then, according to authorities, a heavily armed Holmes entered through an emergency exit and into the dark theater. "When James Holmes walked in that night, I knew something was wrong — no one walks through an emergency exit like that," Han said. Perhaps it was the warning his parents had taught him as a child: be aware of your surroundings. Or perhaps it was instinct. Either way, when the shooting began, Han dropped to the floor. He looked over and saw Davis still seated. He reached up and pulled her down beside him. "I made sure Holmes couldn’t reach her. If anything, I’d put my body between her and the shooter," he said. Bullets tore through seats like butter. Han was struck in the hip and knee. Davis suffered minor cuts and scrapes. For months, as Han recovered medically, Davis stayed by his side. Their bond grew stronger. Months later, during a quiet vacation in Texas, Han proposed. As they drove back to Colorado, he asked Davis if she’d consider marrying on the anniversary of the attack. "I kind of scared her at first — she had to think about it," he said. She thought of how he saved her. She thought of how close she came to losing him. Her answer: yes.

Jeden rok neskôr si táto dvojica tento deň znovu získava, nahradzuje strach, ktorý cítila, láskou, ktorú má k sebe navzájom, keď sa v sobotu oženia — presne jeden rok po streľbe. "Mojím myslením bolo, že každý má deň, ktorý pre neho niečo znamená," povedal Han štvrtok na CNN Piers Morgan Live. "Pre nás to bola noc teroru. Tak sme chceli to zmeniť — urobiť ho svojím vlastným." Prežiť túto noc bola skoro nemožná. 20. júla 2012 boli Han a Davis na rande na polnočnom premietaní filmu 'The Dark Knight Rises.' Poznali sa už od základnej školy, ale teraz v kine boli mladým párom, ktorý si užíval ich vzťah. Potom, podľa úradov, ťažko ozbrojený Holmes vstúpil cez núdzový východ do tmavého kina. "Keď James Holmes vstúpil túto noc, vedel som, že sa niečo stane — nikto neprechádza cez núdzový východ takto," povedal Han. Možno to bol varovanie, ktoré mu jeho rodiče povedali, keď bol dieťaťom: buď si vedomý svojho okolia. Alebo možno to bol instinkt. V každom prípade, keď začala streľba, Han spadol na zem. Pozrel sa a videl, že Davis stále sedí. Natiahol sa a ťahal ju dolu vedľa seba. "Uistil som sa, že Holmes nemôže dostať k nej. Akokoľvek, aspoň som dal svoje telo medzi ňu a streľcu," povedal. Ich väzba sa posilnila. Mesiacom neskôr, počas tichého dovolenky v Texase, Han požiadal. Keď sa vracali späť do Colorada, spýtal sa Davis, či by chcela oženiť sa v ročnici útoku. "Najprv som ju trochu vydial — musela o tom premyslieť," povedal. Premyslela si, ako ju zachránil. Premyslela si, akoby ju mohla stratiť. Jej odpoveď: áno.

article_content: The iPhone 4S smashed sales records, hitting 4 million units sold in its first weekend—but it didn’t fly without a few bumps. While it avoided a crisis like the iPhone 4’s 'Antennagate,' early adopters quickly flagged several issues. Some, like activation delays, likely stemmed from launch-day overload. Others raised more serious questions. Sprint users reported painfully slow data speeds, sparking hundreds of forum posts asking if Apple’s phone was throttling their network. Sprint responded by highlighting its record sales and pointing to independent speed tests that contradicted the complaints. Battery life, meanwhile, disappointed many: Apple claimed eight hours of talk time, but iLounge’s testing showed the 4S drained faster than the iPhone 4 during video playback and 3G browsing—even though the battery was only slightly bigger. Siri, the flagship AI feature, struggled internationally. Location-based commands like 'Find a coffee shop nearby' didn’t work outside the U.S., and even simple questions like 'What time is it?' failed in Canada. Non-native English speakers also found Siri hard to understand due to limited accent recognition. The 8-megapixel camera delivered stunning photos, but some users experienced shutter delays or frozen lenses, often resolved by restarting the device. Finally, a small number of owners noticed a faint yellow tint on their screens—a known quirk from earlier iPhones, likely caused by leftover manufacturing residue that typically fades within days. Apple has not issued any public statement regarding these concerns.

Niektoré, ako oneskorenia pri aktivácii, pravdepodobne vznikli kvôli preťaženiu počas štartu. Iné vyvolali vážnejšie otázky. Používatelia Sprintu hlásili trápne pomalé rýchlosti dát, čo vyvolalo stovky príspevkov na fóre, kde sa pýtali, či Appleho telefón nesťažuje ich sieť. Sprint odpovedal zdôraznením svojich rekordných predajov a ukázal nezávislé testy rýchlosti, ktoré tieto stížnosti vyvracali. Životnosť batérie sa medzitým zmluvila mnohým: Apple tvrdil osem hodín hovoru, ale testy iLounge ukázali, že 4S sa vybíja rýchlejšie ako iPhone 4 počas prehrávania videa a prehliadania webu cez 3G – aj keď batéria bola len o málo väčšia. Neanglicky hovoriaci používatelia tiež zistili, že im Siri ťažko rozumie kvôli obmedzenému rozpoznávaniu akcentov. 8-megapixelová kamera dodávala úžasnú kvalitu obrázkov, ale niektorí používatelia zažili oneskorenie spustenia alebo zamrznutie objektívu, ktoré bolo často vyriešené reštartovaním zariadenia. article_content: After a ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), Kazakh cyclist Alexander Vinokourov is cleared to return to competition just two days before the 2009 Tour de France finishes in Paris. Originally handed a one-year ban by his national federation following his expulsion from the 2007 Tour de France for blood doping, Vinokourov’s suspension was challenged by the UCI, which argued the penalty should have been two years under international rules. The dispute led to arbitration, and CAS has now confirmed the longer ban — retroactive to July 24, 2007 — making him eligible again on July 24, 2009. Though he announced retirement after the scandal, Vinokourov has publicly voiced intentions to make a comeback, ideally joining Team Astana alongside stars like Lance Armstrong and Alberto Contador. In a recent interview, he shared his dream of capping his career by winning the 2010 World Championship and wearing the rainbow jersey one final time.

Pôvodne mu jeho národná federácia uložila trest jedného roka po jeho vylúčení z Tour de France 2007 kvôli krvnému dopingu. Medzinárodná cyklistická únia (UCI) vyvolala námietku, že trest mal byť podľa medzinárodných pravidiel dva roky. Spor bol odložený na arbitráž, pri ktorej CAS potvrdil dlhší trest — spätne účinný od 24. júla 2007 — čím je Vinokourov znovu oprávnený súťažiť od 24. júla 2009. Aj keď po skandále oznámil odchod do dôchodku, Vinokourov verejne vyjadril záujem o návrat, najradšej do tímu Astana spolu so hviezdami ako Lance Armstrong a Alberto Contador. (CNN) -- Formula One driver Mark Webber has signed a new contract with Red Bull Racing, extending his stay with the team through the end of the 2013 season. The Australian secured his second victory of the season at the rain-soaked British Grand Prix on Sunday, narrowing the gap in the drivers' championship to 13 points behind leader Fernando Alonso. 'I've been with Red Bull Racing since 2007 and have earned nine Grand Prix wins during that time,' Webber said on the team's official website. 'I'm feeling highly confident right now and performing at my best. I know the team inside out, and I'm completely comfortable here. We've grown together over the years, and staying with Red Bull for another season feels like the right decision.'

Team principal Christian Horner commented: 'Much of Mark's Formula One success has come during his tenure with Red Bull Racing. Together, we've achieved 10 pole positions, nine victories, and 31 podium finishes. Given the mutual desire to continue our partnership, extending our collaboration was a natural step — and we're pleased to confirm Mark will race for us in 2013.'

Rumors had swirled about a potential move to rival Ferrari at the end of the current season, but Webber dismissed them outright: 'There were discussions with Ferrari, but my choice was to stay here.'

With the combined efforts of Webber and double world champion Sebastian Vettel, Red Bull currently holds a commanding 64-point lead in the constructors' championship over Ferrari, who haven't finished atop the standings since 2008.

The relationship between the two Red Bull drivers has often been viewed as tense, particularly after their collision at the 2010 Turkish Grand Prix. Yet Webber quickly downplayed any lingering friction. Regarding his partnership with Vettel, he said: 'Obviously, Seb and I have worked extremely closely for a long time. Few could have predicted how enduring our collaboration would be — that's been somewhat surprising. Very few teammates in Formula One stay together this long, but our partnership has proven successful, built on hard work alongside the team's key technical staff. It's been a potent combination. We're still competitive every time we hit the track. Last year, there wasn't much racing between Sebastian and me, but in 2009, 2010, and this year, we've had some thrilling battles.'

When asked about his future beyond 2013, Webber remained cryptic: 'Formula One at the front of the grid is results-driven. My future is in my own hands — it depends on the results I deliver on track.'

'Som s tímom Red Bull Racing od roku 2007 a počas tejto doby som získal deväť víťazstiev veľkých cien,' povedal Webber na oficiálnej webovej stránke tímu. 'Teraz sa cítim veľmi sebavedome a pracujem na maximálnej úrovni. Dobre poznám tím a cítim sa tu úplne príjemne. Spolu sme sa rozvíjali roky a zostávať s Red Bullom ešte na jeden rok je podľa mňa správne rozhodnutie.'

Hlavný manažér tímu Christian Horner komentoval: 'Veľká časť Markovej úspešnosti vo Formule 1 prišla počas jeho pôsobenia v Red Bull Racing. Spolu sme dosiahli 10 pózií, deväť víťazstiev a 31 umiestnení na stupni víťazov. Keďže obidve strany mali silnú túžbu pokračovať vo vzájomnom partnerstve, predĺženie našich vzťahov bolo logickým krokom — a s veľkou radosťou potvrdzujeme, že Mark bude pre nás jazdiť aj v roku 2013.'

Počas posledného obdobia sa šírili spekulácie o možnom presune do talianskeho súpera Ferrari, ale Webber ich odmietol: 'Boli rozhovory s Ferrari, ale môj výber bol zostať tu.'

Spoločnými úsiliami Webbera a dvojnásobného majstra sveta Sebastiana Vettela má Red Bull aktuálne pohodlné vedenie v konštruktérskom pohári o 64 bodov pred Ferrari, ktoré nevyhralo titul od roku 2008.

Vzťah medzi dvoma jazdiermi Red Bullu sa často považoval za napätý, najmä po ich kolízii na veľkej cene Turecka v roku 2010. Webber však rýchlo zmiernil akékoľvek podozrenia z nepriateľstva. Pri hovore o spolupráci s Vettelom povedal: 'Samozrejme, Seb a ja už veľmi dlho pracujeme veľmi blízko. Nikto by skutočne nečakal, ako dlho budeme spolu pracovať — to bolo trochu prekvapením. Veľmi málo tímových kolegov vo Formule 1 spolu tak dlho pracuje, ale naša spolupráca sa ukázala ako úspešná, postavená na tvrdej práci spolu s kľúčovými technikmi tímu. Bola to silná kombinácia. Vždy, keď vyjdeme na trať, sme stále konkurenční. Minulý rok medzi Sebastianom a mnou nebolo veľa pretekania, ale v rokoch 2009, 2010 a tento rok sme mali niektoré skvelé závody.'

Keď ho opýtali na jeho budúcnosť po roku 2013, Webber zostal nejasný: 'Formula 1 na čele pořadí je závislá na výsledkoch. Moja budúcnosť je v mojich rukách — záleží na tom, aké výsledky dosiahnem na trati.'

article_content: Over a year ago, Hulu announced it would revive Futurama, Matt Groening’s other hugely popular animated series that originally aired on Fox. Early days were uncertain: it seemed unlikely that John DiMaggio would reprise his iconic role as Bender, not to mention how often the show had been canceled and revived before. But the strong performance of the first season convinced Hulu to renew Futurama for two additional seasons—totaling 20 new episodes. Production-wise, this brings the series to 11 seasons, though 14 when counting broadcast seasons due to the Comedy Central era. Futurama is a flagship title in Hulu’s 'Animayhem' hub, which features adult animation and anime such as Solar Opposites, Chainsaw Man, and Family Guy. The revival remained in Nielsen’s Top 10 Original Series for two-thirds of its run. As of now, the entire original cast is confirmed to return without any renegotiation. The first half of Hulu’s 20-episode order aired in September; the second half is expected in 2024. While not every episode has been a home run, enough landed to keep fans invested in the next chapter. It remains unclear how long Hulu will continue the series—its revival of Animaniacs ended after just a few seasons—but Futurama benefits from stronger cultural memory, bolstered by its multiple revivals and the enduring popularity of The Simpsons. If you’ve watched the new season, share your thoughts in the comments. Want more io9 updates? Find out when to expect the latest Marvel, Star Wars, and Star Trek releases, what’s coming next for the DC Universe on screen, and everything you need to know about Doctor Who’s future.

Začiatky boli neisté: zdalo sa, že John DiMaggio nebude znovu hrať svoju ikonickú úlohu Bendera, natož ako často bol tento seriál zrušený a následne obnovený. Ale silný výkon prvej sezóny presvedčil Hulu obnoviť Futurama o ďalšie dve sezóny — celkovo 20 nových dielov. Z produkčného hľadiska to znamená 11 sezón, avšak 14, ak počítame aj vysielanie na Comedy Central. Futurama je hlavným titulom v hubi Hulu 'Animayhem', ktorý predstavuje dospelú animáciu a anime ako Solar Opposites, Chainsaw Man alebo Family Guy. Obnova zostávala v Nielsenovej top 10 najlepších originálnych seriálov počas dvoch tretín svojej premiéry. V súčasnosti je potvrdené, že celý pôvodný obsadenie sa vráti bez potreby ďalších vyjednávaní. Prvá polovica 20-dielného objednávky Hulu bola odvysielaná v septembri; druhá polovica sa očakáva v roku 2024. Nie je jasné, ako dlho Hulu seriál ešte bude pokračovať — jeho obnova seriálu Animaniacs skončila po niekoľkých sezónach — ale Futurama má výhodu silnejšej kultúrnej pamäti, podporenej viacerými obnovami a trvalou popularitou Simpsonov. article_content: The word 'selfie' was named Word of the Year by the Oxford English Dictionary — and Britain’s passion for snapping the perfect self-portrait shows no signs of fading. New research indicates over 17 million selfies are uploaded to social media every week in the UK. Inspired by celebrities like Kim Kardashian and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, people are increasingly searching for ways to enhance their photo appearances. Avon has responded with the Ultra Colour Bold Lipstick — a £7.50 formula featuring revolutionary Pigment Loading Technology and a translucent base designed to let color burst through in photos, unlike traditional lipsticks that dull vibrancy with opaque carriers. Lisa Lamberty from Avon’s R&D team says the product was developed so women can look their best in pictures without heavy makeup. Makeup artist Liz Pugh adds that bold lips are a simple, powerful tool — drawing attention to the mouth and minimizing the need for contouring or dramatic eye makeup. She personally recommends Magenta Flash and Bold Bordeaux for standout looks. When tested by FEMAIL, these shades delivered intense color that lasted hours, though editors advised saving them for evening outings rather than daytime offices. With 10 vibrant options available, Avon isn’t just launching a lipstick — it’s offering a new way to express confidence through the lens of a smartphone.

article_content: Before a scheduled performance at Webster Hall in Manhattan, former Cro-Mags bassist Harley Flanagan, 42, stormed into a dressing room and attacked two current band members with a hunting knife. The incident occurred just before the band was set to take the stage as part of the CBGB Festival. Flanagan, a founding member of the influential hardcore band, forced his way through the venue’s VIP area before launching the assault. One victim, bassist William Berario, 45, sustained a slash above the eye and a bite to the cheek. The other, current bassist Michael Couls, 33 — known in the scene as 'The Gook' — was injured on the arm and stomach. Both were treated at Bellevue Hospital for non-life-threatening wounds. Witnesses described Flanagan as behaving erratically in the hours before the attack. One attendee recalled speaking to him moments earlier and sensing something was wrong. As the violence erupted, bystanders shouted warnings, and security personnel subdued Flanagan, who has training in Jiu-Jitsu. During the struggle, he suffered a broken leg. Police arrived and placed Flanagan under arrest. He was later handcuffed to a chair, visibly injured, and transported to the hospital. He faces two counts of second-degree assault and weapons-related charges. The concert, which also featured the band Sick of It All, was immediately canceled. Cro-Mags lead singer John Joseph McGowan addressed the crowd afterward, saying, 'You can all thank Harley Flanagan for ruining the night for everyone.'

Incidencia sa odohrala práve pred tým, ako mala banda vystúpiť ako súčasť festivalu CBGB. Flanagan, zakladajúci člen vplyvného hardcore bandu, vtrhol do VIP sekcie, predtým než začal s útokom. Jedným z postihnutých bol basista William Berario, 45, ktorý utrpel rez na oči a uštipnutie na tvári. Druhým bol súčasný basista Michael Couls, 33 — známy v hardcore scéne ako 'The Gook' — ktorý bol zranený na paži a brucho. Oboje boli liečení v nemocnici Bellevue pre neživotne ohrozené zranenia. Svedkovia popísali Flanaganovo správanie ako nezvyčajné v hodinách pred útokom. Jeden návštevník si pripomínal, že s ním hovoril chvíľu predtým a cítil, že sa niečo zlé stane. Keď sa začal násilný útok, okolní ľudia volali varovania a bezpečnostníci ho zadržali; Flanagan má skúsenosti s Jiu-Jitsu a počas zápasu si zlomil nohu. Policajti prišli a Flanaganovi vydali zatykač. Neskôr bol prichytený k stoličke, viditeľne zranený, a prepravený do nemocnice. Je obvinený z dvoch bodiek druhého stupňa útoku a zbraní. Koncert, ktorý tiež zahŕňal vystúpenie bandu Sick of It All, bol ihneď zrušený. Vokalistka Cro-Mags John Joseph McGowan sa po incidente obrátila na publikum a povedala: 'Môžete všetci poďakovať Harley Flanaganovi za pokazenie noci pre všetkých.'

article_content: Crystal Palace and Swansea City are keen on Hamilton Academical's rising star, Stephen Hendrie. The talented left-back is being tipped to follow in the footsteps of Hull City's Andrew Robertson, who flourished after his £2.8 million move from Dundee United and became Scotland's first-choice full-back. Scouts from both Premier League clubs watched Hendrie in a behind-closed-doors friendly against West Bromwich Albion earlier this month and attended Saturday's victory over St Mirren. Cardiff City have also monitored Hendrie, who is valued at approximately £2 million by Hamilton. The 19-year-old has been a regular member of Hamilton's first team since 2011 and has represented Scotland at U17, U19, and U21 levels. Hendrie made his Scotland U21 debut in September and has since earned two additional caps.

article_content: By Jason Groves and Ian Drury for the Daily Mail. Following the brutal killing of British soldier Lee Rigby by extremist attackers wielding cleavers in broad daylight outside Woolwich Barracks in May 2013, Prime Minister David Cameron established an extremism taskforce to combat radicalization. Yet months later, none of the taskforce’s key recommendations have been implemented, sparking widespread criticism as reports emerge that up to 2,000 British citizens may have traveled to Syria and Iraq to join ISIS. Labour MP Khalid Mahmood disputed official estimates of 500, asserting the real number is closer to 2,000 and that individuals continue to leave the UK due to inadequate border controls. The taskforce, which submitted its findings in December 2013, proposed measures such as 'terror Asbos' against hate preachers, bans on groups promoting hate speech or undermining democracy, and enhanced powers for the Charity Commission to shut down terror-linked charities. None have been enacted. Only 57 extremist websites have been shut down, and no comprehensive government strategy document has been published since the taskforce’s formation. Experts like Ghaffar Hussain of Quilliam and Professor Anthony Glees of the University of Buckingham argue that extremist ideologies have flourished under the guise of religion, free speech, and multiculturalism. The UK’s 2013 parliamentary vote against military intervention in Syria drew criticism from French President François Hollande, who claimed that delayed Western action contributed to the rise of ISIS. The Prevent strategy—launched after the 2005 London bombings with over £200 million in funding—was later deemed ineffective, with some funds inadvertently supporting extremist groups. Government officials maintain they are actively addressing extremism in schools, prisons, and through legal tools to disrupt travel and prosecute offenders, but concrete public actions remain limited.

Po brutálnom zabití britského vojaka Lee Rigbyho extrémistami so sekerami na svetle dňa vonku od Woolwich Barracks v máji 2013 vytvoril premiér David Cameron úložisko na boj proti radikalizácii. Avšak mesiace neskôr neboli implementované žiadne z kľúčových odporúčaní úložiska, čo vyvolalo širokú kritiku, keď sa objavili správy, že až 2 000 britských občanov sa mohlo vydalo do Sýrie a Iraku, aby sa pripojili k ISIS. Poslanec Labouru Khalid Mahmood vyvrátil oficiálne odhady 500 a tvrdil, že skutočné číslo je bližšie k 2 000 a že ľudia stále opúšťajú Spojené kráľovstvo kvôli neprimeraným hranicným kontrolám. Úložisko, ktoré predložilo svoje zistenia v decembri 2013, navrhlo opatrenia ako 'teroristické Asbos' proti nenávistným kazateľom, zákazy skupín, ktoré podkopávajú demokraciu alebo používajú nenávisť, a rozšírené právomoci pre Komisiu pre charitatívne organizácie na uzatvorenie charitatívnych skupín spojených s terorizmom. Žiadne z nich neboli vykonané. Bolo zatvorených iba 57 extrémistických webov a od vzniku úložiska nebola publikovaná žiadna komplexná vládna stratégia. Odborníci ako Ghaffar Hussain z Quilliam a profesor Anthony Glees z Univerzity v Buckinghamu tvrdia, že extrémistické ideológie prosperovali pod krytím náboženstva, slobody slova a multikulturalizmu. Britské hlasovanie v roku 2013 proti vojenskej intervencii v Sýrii vyvolalo kritiku francúzskeho prezidenta François Hollanda, ktorý tvrdil, že oneskorená akcia Západu prispela k vzniku ISIS. Stratégia Prevent — spustená po bombových útokoch v Londýne v roku 2005 s viac ako 200 miliónmi libier — bola neskôr považovaná za neúspešnú, keď niektoré prostriedky neúmyselne podporovali extrémistické skupiny. Vládni úradníci uvádzajú, že aktívne riešia extrémizmus v školách, väzeniach a prostredníctvom právnych nástrojov na prerušenie cestovania a súdenie porušovateľov zákona, ale konkrétne verejné opatrenia zostávajú obmedzené.

article_content: A pair of American visitors to Greece found themselves in an unexpected situation when airport security in Athens flagged six human skulls hidden in their carry-on bags. The tourists, who had purchased the items from a souvenir shop on the island of Mykonos, insisted they believed the skulls were replicas meant for Halloween decor. After a forensic examination confirmed the skulls were indeed human, local police briefly detained them on charges related to disturbing human remains. However, with no evidence of criminal intent — and given the tourists’ clear lack of awareness — authorities released them without pressing formal charges. The pair boarded their connecting flight back to the United States shortly after. Officials have not yet determined where the skulls originally came from, nor whether their sale was legal under Greek law.

Turisti, ktorí si predmety zakúpili v obchode so spomienkami na ostrove Mykonos, tvrdili, že verili, že sú to repliky určené na výzdobu domov na Halloweena. Po forenznej skúške boli lebky potvrdené ako ľudské, miestna polícia ich krátko zadržala na podozrenie z porušenia pokojúceho sa mŕtveho. Avšak pri absencii dôkazov o trestnej vôle a s ohľadom na jasné nevedomosť turistov, úrady ich uvoľnili bez podania trestného oznámenia. Dvojica následne nastúpila na svoj spojený let späť do Spojených štátov. Úradníci zatiaľ nezistili, odkiaľ lebky pochádzajú, ani či ich predaj bol legálny podľa gréckeho práva.

article_content: Timothy Levins, a 52-year-old father from Missouri, died approximately 30 minutes after being bitten by a copperhead snake while camping with his family at Sam A. Baker State Park, about 100 miles south of St. Louis. His 11-year-old son, Liam Levins, told police that his father stepped outside their rented cabin, saw the snake, picked it up, and was bitten. Levins returned inside to wash his hands, began shaking shortly afterward, and collapsed on a couch, according to the St. Louis Post-Dispatch. First responders arrived around 9 p.m. and found him unresponsive. He was rushed to a nearby hospital and pronounced dead. The copperhead, measuring 18–20 inches, delivered three bites to his hand. An autopsy later revealed that Levins died from anaphylactic shock triggered by the bite, the coroner said. This marks only the third fatal snakebite in Missouri state history, according to KSDK. Previous incidents occurred in 2012 and 1965. 'That's just a horrible thing,' said camper Bonnie Roberts to KFVS. Sara Turner of the Missouri Department of Conservation noted that most deaths from copperhead bites are not caused by venom, but by pre-existing medical conditions. The department emphasizes that most copperhead bites are 'dry' — meaning no venom is injected — and that the snakes typically strike only to defend themselves, not to kill. Park officials and experts advise: if you encounter a copperhead or any snake, make loud noises or back away slowly to scare it off. Never attempt to handle it. Levins is survived by his wife and three children.
translated_content: Timothy Levins, 52-ročný otec z Missourí, zomrel približne 30 minút po tom, ako ho uštiepil kovadlín, keď bol s rodinou na kempingu v národnom parku Sam A. Baker, asi 160 km južne od St. Louis. Jeho 11-ročný syn, Liam Levins, povedal polícii, že jeho otec vyšiel von z prenajatého chatka, uvidel hada, zobral ho do rúk a bol uštiepaný. Levins sa vrátil dovnútra umyć si ruky, krátko potom začal trpieť kŕčmi a zosval na kresle, podľa St. Louis Post-Dispatch. Záchranné tímy dorazili okolo 21:00 a našli ho bez priznakov života. Bol prevezený do blízkej nemocnice, kde bol oznámený za mŕtveho. Kovadlín dlhý 45–50 cm mu uštiepal trikrát do ruky. Autopsia ukázala, že Levins zomrel na anafylaktický šok spôsobený uštiepaním, povedal korener. Toto je už tretí smrteľný prípad uštiepania hadom v histórii štátu Missouri, podľa KSDK. Predchádzajúce prípady sa stali v roku 2012 a 1965. 'To je len hrozná vec,' povedal kempingár Bonnie Roberts agentúre KFVS. Sara Turner zo Zákonného úradu pre ochranu prírody Missouri poznamenala, že väčšina úmrtí z dôvodu uštiepania kovadlínom nie je spôsobená jedom, ale predchádzajúcimi zdravotnými problémami. Úrad zdôrazňuje, že väčšina uštiepaní kovadlínom sú 'suché' — teda bez vstreknutia jedu — a že hadi obvykle útočia iba na obranu, nie na zabíjanie. Zamestnanci parku a odborníci odporúčajú: ak narazíte na kovadlína alebo akéhokoľvek hada, vystrašte ho hlasným hlukom alebo pomaly sa vzdialte. Nikdy sa nepokúšajte ho chytiť. Levins sa po smrti necháva po sebe manželku a troch detí.

article_content: In a dramatic rescue on 26 November 2012, 35-year-old David Dunn and his 13-year-old son Cameron saved an elderly man trapped in a submerged vehicle during severe flooding in Keynsham, Somerset. The pair were driving home in their Land Rover when they spotted a car being swept downstream along Broadmead Lane, a flood-prone road near the River Avon. Inside, they could see the elderly occupant, who had become stranded after driving into deep floodwaters. Despite the dangerous currents and rising water, David steered the Land Rover close enough to the stranded vehicle. He climbed onto the bonnet, reached through the driver’s window, and pulled the man to safety. Cameron remained inside the vehicle, filming the rescue. Footage shows the moment the elderly man was pulled onto the bonnet and carried to dry land. The man, believed to be a local resident, was shaken but unharmed. He declined further assistance, saying he simply wanted to return home and change clothes. David, who has ten years of off-roading experience, described the conditions as the worst he’d ever seen in the area. Although he’s driven through deeper water before, the speed and force of the current made this situation exceptionally perilous. By the next day, only about one foot of the submerged car remained visible above the waterline. The incident occurred late on the evening of 25 November 2012, as heavy rains overwhelmed the floodplain.

Dvojica sa vracala domov vo svojom Land Roveri, keď zazreli auto, ktoré bolo unášané riečnym prúdom pozdĺž cesty Broadmead Lane, oblasti náchylnej na povodne pri rieke Avon. V aute videli staršieho muža, ktorý sa ocitol v pasti po tom, čo zavrel do hlbokých vod. Napriek nebezpečným prúdom a stúpajúcemu vodnému hladinu David riadil Land Rover tak blízko k potopenému vozidlu, že sa dokázal vybrať na kapotu, dosiahnuť cez okno vodiča a vytiahnuť muža na bezpečie. Cameron zostal vo vozidle a natáčal záchrannú akciu. Záznam ukazuje okamih, keď bol starší muž vytiahnutý na kapotu a odvezený na suché pôdu. Muž, ktorý sa predpokladá, že žije v blízkosti, bol vydienený, ale nepoškodený. Odmietol ďalšiu pomoc, povedal, že len chce ísť domov a zmeniť odevy. David, ktorý má desaťročné skúsenosti s off-road jazdou, opísal podmienky ako najhoršie, aké kedy v tejto oblasti videl. Aj keď už niekedy prejazdil hlbšou vodou, rýchlosť a sila prúdu urobili túto situáciu výnimočne nebezpečnou. O deň neskôr bolo nad hladinou vody vidieť iba približne 30 cm auta. Incidencia sa odohrala neskoro večer 25. novembra 2012, keď silné dažde preplnili povodňovú rovinu.

article_content: After 27 years of unanswered questions, Katheryn Deprill finally met the woman who gave birth to her — not in a dramatic public setting, but quietly, in an attorney’s office in Allentown, Pennsylvania. The moment, described by Deprill as 'pure joy,' ended decades of searching that began with a simple Facebook post. In March, she shared a photo holding a sign pleading for help finding her birth mother, who had left her as a newborn, wrapped in a shirt, crying on the bathroom floor of a Burger King. The post went viral, shared over 30,000 times worldwide, drawing global attention and, eventually, the attention of the woman herself. The birth mother, now a married woman in her late 30s, had been living with deep regret. She revealed to attorney John Waldron that at age 16, while traveling abroad with her family, she was raped and became pregnant. Ashamed and afraid, she hid the pregnancy, gave birth alone at home, and felt unable to take her baby to the hospital. Instead, she chose to leave her in a place where she hoped someone would care for her — not abandon her. 'She didn’t want to throw me away,' Deprill said. 'She left me somewhere she knew I’d be found.' When they met, Deprill immediately saw herself in her mother’s face. 'It looked like I was looking in a mirror,' she recalled. They embraced for the first time — a hug Deprill had dreamed of for nearly three decades. The meeting lasted four hours. They exchanged numbers, shared medical history, and spoke openly about the past. Deprill forgave her completely. 'I forgave her 110 percent,' she said. Her adoptive mother, Brenda Hollis, who raised her with love and supported her search, was present with Deprill’s infant son, Jackson, making the moment even more meaningful. Though the original investigation in 1986 yielded no leads — police had only a description of a young woman with frizzy sandy-brown hair driving a blue 1970s car — the power of social media cracked the case open. The birth mother, overwhelmed by fear and guilt, sought legal counsel before stepping forward, wanting to do things right. Now, both women plan to build a relationship. 'We’re definitely going to keep in touch,' Deprill said. 'This isn’t the end. It’s just the beginning.'
translated_content: Po 27 rokoch neodpovedaných otázok sa Katheryn Deprill konečne stretla s ženou, ktorá jej dala narodiť — nie v dramatickom verejnom prostredí, ale ticho v kancelárii právnika v Allentowne, Pensylvánia. Tento okamih, ktorý Deprill opísala ako 'čistú radosť', ukončil desaťročia hľadania, ktoré začali jednoduchým príspevkom na Facebooku. V marci zverejnila fotografiu s tabuľkou, v ktorej prosila o pomoc pri hľadaní svojej biologickej matky, ktorá ju nechala ako novorodenca, zabaleného v košeli, plakajúceho na podlahe toalety v Burger Kingu. Príspevok sa stal virálnym, zdieľaný viac ako 30 000 krát po celom svete, privádzajúc pozornosť globálnej verejnosti a nakoniec aj pozornosť samej ženy. Biologická mama, teraz manželka vo veku konca 30. rokov, žila s hlbokým litovanim. Právnikovi Johnovi Waldronovi odhalila, že v šestnástich rokoch, počas cesty s rodinou zahraničím, bola znásilnená a tehotná. Hanbou a strachom skrývala tehotenstvo, porodila sama doma a pociťovala, že nemôže svoje dieťa odviezť do nemocnice. Namiesto toho sa rozhodla nechať ho v mieste, kde dúfala, že ho niekto postará — nie ho zahodiť. 'Nechcela ma zahodiť,' povedala Deprill. 'Nechala ma tam, kde vedela, že ma niekto nájde.' Keď sa stretli, Deprill okamžite videla seba vo svojej mame. 'Vyzeralo to, ako keby som sa pozerala do zrkadla,' spomenula si. Poprvé sa objali — empatia, ktorú Deprill snila po témno troch desaťročiach. Stretnutie trvalo štyri hodiny. Vymenili si čísla, zdieľali medicínsku históriu a otvorene hovorili o minulosti. Deprill jej úplne odpustila. 'Odpustila som jej 110 percent,' povedala. Jej adoptívna mama, Brenda Hollis, ktorá ju vychovávala s láskou a podporovala jej hľadanie, bola prítomná spolu s Deprillovým najmladším synom, Jacksom, čo urobilo tento okamih ešte významnejší. Aj keď pôvodné vyšetrovanie v roku 1986 nedalo žiadne výsledky — polícia mala len popis mladej ženy s rozprášenými, blízko krku, lesklými hnedými vlasmi, ktorá riadila modrý autom z 70. rokov — sila sociálnych médií otvorila prípad. Biologická mama, prekvapená strachom a vinou, vyhľadala právnu pomoc pred tým, ako sa ozvala, chcela spraviť veci správne. Teraz obe ženy plánujú budovať vzťah. 'Udržiavame kontakt,' povedala Deprill. 'To nie je koniec. Je to len začiatok.'

article_content: In a historic ruling, a Canadian court has convicted Franco Orr Yiu-kwan, a 50-year-old man from Hong Kong, of human trafficking for exploiting his Filipino domestic worker, Leticia Sarmiento. This marks Canada’s first conviction under human trafficking laws for forced domestic servitude. Sarmiento, 40, testified that after arriving in Vancouver in 2008, she was forced to work 16 hours a day, seven days a week, with no days off, holidays, or contact with the outside world. She said her passport was confiscated and she was kept isolated. Her situation came to a breaking point in June 2010, when she called police after a confrontation with Orr’s partner, Nicole Huen. Huen was acquitted, as the jury believed Sarmiento’s claims against Orr but not those against her. Orr’s defense lawyer, Nicholas Preovolos, countered that Sarmiento had actively sought to move to Canada, stayed past her visa expiration despite being offered a return flight, and only contacted authorities after being given another ticket home — hoping to remain in the country permanently. One defense witness stated Sarmiento voluntarily gave her passport when attempting to open a Canadian bank account, challenging her claim of confiscation. Orr remains on bail pending sentencing on July 10, facing a potential sentence of life in prison and a $1 million fine.

Ide o prvý prípad v Kanade, keď niekto bol odsúdený pod zákonom o obchode ľuďmi za nútenú domácu prácu. Sarmiento, 40, vyhlásila, že po príchode do Vankúveru v roku 2008 bola nútená pracovať 16 hodín denne, sedem dní v týždni, bez dňa voľna, sviatkov ani kontaktu s vonkajším svetom. Povedala, že jej bol zabranený pas a bola izolovaná. Jej situácia dosiahla bod, kedy sa obrátila na políciu v júni 2010, po konflikte so spoločníčkou Orra, Nicole Huen. Huen bola oslobodená, pretože porota verila tvrdeniam Sarmiento voči Orrovi, ale nie voči nej. Obranca Orra, Nicholas Preovolos, tvrdil, že Sarmiento aktívne požiadala o presun do Kanady, zostala po uplynutí víza, napriek tomu, že jej bolo ponúknuté návratné letenka, a kontaktovala úradníkov až po tom, čo jej boli znovu ponúknuté letenky domov, aby mohla zostať v krajine trvalo. Jeden svedok obrany vyhlásil, že Sarmiento dobrovoľne odovzdala svoj pas pri pokuse o otvorenie kanadskej bankovej účtu, čo vyvrací jej tvrdenie o zabraní pasu. Orr zostáva na kaucií do výroku rozsudku 10. júla, ktorý môže byť až doživotný trest a pokuta 1 milióna dolárov.

article_content: Barack Obama stands alone in modern U.S. history as the only president to make two separate visits to Normandy during his time in office — both timed for major D-Day anniversaries. While four sitting presidents have attended these commemorations, Obama’s dual trips mark a unique personal and symbolic commitment to honoring the past. Before Reagan’s powerful 1984 address atop Pointe du Hoc, no sitting president had ever traveled to the site; instead, they issued formal statements from Washington. Reagan’s speech, delivered before 62 weathered veterans of the Army Rangers who scaled the cliffs under heavy fire, became legendary: 'These are the boys of Pointe du Hoc... the heroes who helped end a war.' His words turned the site into a living memorial. Eisenhower, who planned the invasion, didn’t return until after his presidency. Johnson spoke from the White House in 1964, tying D-Day’s sacrifice to the fight for civil rights. Nixon, embroiled in Watergate, sent General Bradley as his proxy in 1974. Clinton, in 1994, saw the post-Cold War transformation of former enemies into allies and challenged Americans to continue defending freedom. Bush, in 2004, honored his father’s wartime service while reflecting on the moral clarity of defeating fascism. In 2009, Obama brought his own family’s story into the narrative — his grandfather had crossed the Channel weeks after D-Day — and reminded the world that courage isn’t reserved for the extraordinary, but often rises in ordinary people when history demands it.

Hoci štyria sediaci prezidenti navšívili tieto pripomienkové akcie, Obamaove dvojité návštevy znamenajú jedinečný osobný a symbolický záväzok k pocte minulosti. Pred Reaganovým silným prejavom v roku 1984 na vrchole Pointe du Hoc nikdy nechodil žiadny sediaci prezident na miesto; namiesto toho vydávali formálne vyhlásenia z Washigntonu. Reaganov prejav, vykonaný pred 62 vyčerpanými veteránmi armádnych rangerov, ktorí vyliezli na skalnaté útesy pod ťažkým ohňom, sa stal legendárnym: 'Toto sú chlapci z Pointe du Hoc... hrdinovia, ktorí pomohli skončiť vojnu.' Jeho slová premenili miesto na živú pamiatku. Eisenhower, ktorý plánoval inváziu, nevrátil sa až po skončení svojho úradovania. Johnson hovoril z Bielého domu v roku 1964, prepojujúc obetavosť D-Dne s bojom za občianske práva. Nixon, zapletený do Watergate, poslal generála Bradleya ako svojho zástupcu v roku 1974. Clinton v roku 1994 videl transformáciu bývalých nepriateľov po studenej vojne v spojencov a vyzval Američanov, aby pokračovali v obrane slobody. Bush v roku 2004 poctil vojenskú službu svojho otca a premýšľal o morálnej jasnosti víťazstva nad fašizmom. V roku 2009 Obama zahrnul do príbehu aj svoju vlastnú rodinnú históriu – jeho dedko preplával kanál niekoľko týždňov po D-Dni – a pripomenul svetu, že odvaha nie je výhradne vlastnosťou výnimočných ľudí, ale často vyrastá z bežných ľudí, keď ju od v histórie vyžaduje.

article_content: A woman whose vagina had become so narrow due to scleroderma that sexual intercourse and even gynecological exams were impossible has undergone a successful reconstructive surgery using a mesh made from pig intestine. She was referred to the University Hospital in Plzeň, western Czech Republic, after her gynecologist could not perform an examination due to extreme vaginal constriction. Doctors there, having learned that similar porcine mesh techniques had been used for bladder reconstruction, decided to adapt the method for vaginal repair — despite no prior documented cases for this specific application. Scleroderma, a connective tissue disorder, causes thickening of the skin and can lead to internal complications, including narrowing of the vaginal opening and reduced lubrication, which severely impact sexual function. The surgical technique employed is called Mesh Augmented Vaginal Reconstruction, typically used for pelvic organ prolapse. In this case, surgeons inserted a 1-millimeter-thick mesh derived from pig intestine to widen the vaginal canal. Porcine tissue is commonly used in medical grafts because its biological structure closely resembles human tissue. Scientists have previously used pig bladder and intestinal materials to regenerate human muscle and skin. During the hour-long procedure, surgeons made a controlled incision and placed the mesh along the vaginal walls. Over time, the patient’s body will absorb the porcine mesh while generating new human tissue around it. The surgery lasted approximately one hour, and the patient was discharged after five days. Dr. Vladimir Kalis, head of the gynecological-obstetrical clinic, noted that while vaginal surgeries are uncommon for this condition — typically performed for the opposite issue — this outcome was transformative. 'The patient is very happy now,' Dr. Kalis said. 'Gynecological exams are no longer painful. We’ve advised her to avoid sexual activity for now, but she should regain a full and active sex life within about two years. Basically, she feels like a woman again.' Hospital spokesperson Gabriela Levorova confirmed that no similar procedure has been published globally, suggesting this may be the first documented case of its kind. The team plans to publish their findings in a peer-reviewed medical journal.
translated_content: Žena, jejíž poch se kvůli sklerodermii zúžil natolik, že pohlavní styk i gynekologické vyšetření byly nemožné, podstoupila úspěšnou rekonstruktivní operaci s použitím sítě vyrobené z prasecího střeva. Byla odeslána na léčbu do Univerzitní nemocnice v Plzni, na západě České republiky, po tom, co jí gynekolog nemohl provést vyšetření kvůli extrémnímu zúžení pochvy. Lékaři tam, kteří se dozvěděli, že podobné techniky s prasecí sítí byly užívány pro rekonstrukci močového měchýře, rozhodli se tuto metodu přizpůsobit pro rekonstrukci pochvy — navzdory tomu, že neexistují žádné dřívější dokumentované případy této konkrétní aplikace. Sklerodermie, pojivové onemocnění, způsobuje ztluštění kůže a může vést k vnitřním komplikacím, včetně zúžení vchodu do pochvy a sníženého množství lubrikace, což vážně ovlivňuje pohlavní funkce. Chirurgická metoda, která byla použita, se jmenuje Mesh Augmented Vaginal Reconstruction, obvykle používaná pro pánevní prolapz. V tomto případě chirurgové vložili 1 mm silnou síť vyrobenou z prasecího střeva, aby rozšířili stěny pochvy. Prasecí tkáň se často používá v transplantacích, protože její biologická struktura připomíná lidskou tkáň. Vědci již dříve použili tkáně z prasecího močového měchýře a střev k regeneraci lidských svalů a kůže. Během hodinové operace chirurgové provedli kontrolovaný řez a umístili síť podél stěn pochvy. Postupně tělo pacientky absorbuje prasecí síť a vytváří novou lidskou tkáň kolem ní. Operace trvala přibližně jednu hodinu a pacientka byla vysazena po pěti dnech. Dr. Vladimir Kalis, šéf gynekologicko-porodnické kliniky, poznamenal, že i když gynekologické operace pro tuto podmínku jsou vzácné — obvykle se provádějí pro opačný problém — tento výsledek byl transformační. 'Pacientka je teď velmi šťastná,' řekl Dr. Kalis. 'Gynekologická vyšetření už nejsou bolestivá. Doporučili jsme jí, aby se na chvíli vyhnula pohlavnímu styku, ale v příštích dvou letech by měla znovu získat plný a aktivní sexuální život. Základně se znovu cítí jako žena.' Mluvčí nemocnice Gabriela Levorová potvrdila, že nebyl nalezen žádný podobný případ publikovaný kdekoliv ve světě, což naznačuje, že se jedná o první dokumentovaný případ svého druhu. Tým plánuje publikovat své výsledky v odborném lékařském časopise.

article_content: (CNN) — Joan Rivers didn’t consider herself one of the boys. And for that, we can be grateful. Over the course of her nearly 50-year career, Rivers explored, overturned, and laughed at every facet of being a woman — from the 1960s pressure to marry to the realities of aging in a youth-obsessed industry — without ever conforming to the expectations of what a female stand-up comedian was 'supposed' to sound like. 'Every woman in comedy is indebted to her,' said Amy Poehler, a veteran of 'Saturday Night Live,' upon Rivers’ death on Thursday at age 81. 'She was there at the beginning — and funny to the end.' The path Rivers helped carve leads directly to female stand-up powerhouses like Kathy Griffin, Sarah Silverman, and Amy Schumer — all of whom match her fearlessness in both subject matter and delivery. But when Rivers began her stand-up career in the late 1950s, that brazenness was unheard of — for women, at least. 'I was talking about having an affair with a married professor — and that wasn’t something a nice Jewish girl talked about,' Rivers told author Yael Kohen in Kohen’s book, 'We Killed: The Rise of Women in American Comedy.' 'I was talking about my mother, desperate to get my sister and me married. I was talking about my gay friend Mr. Phyllis. You just didn’t talk about that. It sounds tame and silly now, but my act spoke to women who couldn’t speak up.' Initially, Rivers wanted to be an actress and took temp jobs while pursuing her dream. But when a fellow secretary noticed she was constantly cracking jokes around the office, Rivers tried comedy. 'I had no idea what I was doing,' Rivers recalled in a 2012 essay for The Hollywood Reporter. 'The white men were doing 'mother-in-law' and 'my wife’s so fat...' jokes. When I went onstage, that just didn’t feel right. So I said, 'Let me talk about my life.'' She wasn’t alone: George Carlin, Woody Allen, and Bill Cosby — rising comedians at the time — also drew from personal experience. But while they shared similar instincts, Rivers still didn’t fit in. 'I never was one of the guys,' Rivers wrote in The Hollywood Reporter. 'I was never asked to hang out. I never thought about it until later. They’d all go to the Stage Delicatessen afterward and talk. I never got to go uptown and have a sandwich with them. So even though I was with them, I wasn’t with them.' And perhaps that was for the better. After her breakout appearance on Johnny Carson’s 'The Tonight Show' in 1965, Rivers made a name for herself as a woman who spoke frankly — and freely — about what it meant to be a woman. The female body, her sex life, the politics of dating — nothing was off-limits. She saw no need to soften her words. A 1967 appearance on 'The Ed Sullivan Show' may now seem dated in its references to single life, but Rivers’ outrage at gender double standards remains strikingly relevant. 'The girl has to be bright, pretty, intelligent, a good sport — 'Howard Johnson’s again, hooray, hooray!' Rivers sarcastically mimicked to roaring laughter. 'It just kills me! A girl, you’re 30, unmarried — you’re an old maid. A man, he’s 90, unmarried — he’s a catch. It’s a whole different thing, isn’t it?' Her candid style made her a natural fit for her own talk show. She proved it as Carson’s frequent guest host and stand-in. As one People magazine critic put it, she became 'the bitchy queen of late night, whose humorous bark left bite marks.' In 1986, Rivers launched 'The Late Show Starring Joan Rivers' — breaking ground as the first woman to host her own late-night talk show. Though it lasted only eight months, her presence shattered a longstanding barrier in television’s male-dominated late-night club. 'You have to be extraordinarily strong without them seeing you be that,' Rivers told CNN in 2013. 'You’re a lion tamer. You must be in total command — yet still feminine, funny, and inquisitive. It’s incredibly tough, especially for women. No one expects a woman to take control. Still.' But they do. From Chelsea Handler, who ended her successful run on E! to launch something new on Netflix, to Schumer, who earned her first Emmy nomination for her Comedy Central show, to icons like Ellen DeGeneres and Whoopi Goldberg — the women who followed Rivers haven’t always been as controversial, but all share her tenacity. Kathy Griffin is perhaps the clearest heir to Rivers’ legacy. Like Rivers, Griffin excels at skewering celebrities with a smile — while ruthlessly mocking herself. Her Emmy-winning reality series, 'Kathy Griffin: My Life on the D-List,' was a self-deprecating chronicle of her struggle to make it in Hollywood. It’s easy to imagine Rivers making a similar show had she been born decades later. (After all, Rivers kept working relentlessly until her death, appearing alongside her daughter Melissa in reality shows and gleefully roasting celebrities on E!’s 'Fashion Police.') Reflecting on Rivers in her 2010 documentary 'A Piece of Work,' Griffin captured her enduring influence: 'Much in the way that Phyllis Diller paved the way for her, I wouldn’t be doing this if it weren’t for Joan.'
translated_content: (CNN) — Joan Rivers sa nepovažovala za jednu z chlapcov. A za to môžeme byť vďační. Počas svojej takmer 50-ročnej kariéry Rivers objavovala, obracala a smiala sa zo všetkých aspektov bytia ženy — od tlaku v 60. rokoch na oženenie sa po skutočnosť starnutia v odvetví sústredenom na mladosť — ani raz sa nevzdala očakávaniam, akým by mala znieť ženská štandardná komička. 'Každá žena v komédii je jej dlžníčkou,' povedala Amy Poehler, veteranka 'Saturday Night Live', po Riversinej smrti v štvrtok vo veku 81 rokov. 'Bola tam na začiatku — a zábavná až do konca.' Cesta, ktorú Rivers pomohla vytesať, nás viedla priamo k ženským hviezdam stand-up komédie ako Kathy Griffin, Sarah Silverman a Amy Schumer — všetky neohroženej ako Rivers v príkladoch aj ich cieľoch. Ale keď Rivers začala so svojou stand-up komédiou v pozdných 50. rokoch, táto odvaha bola pre ženy nepočúvaná. 'Hovorila som o vzťahu s oženeným profesorom — a to niečo, čo dobrá židovská dievčina nehovorila,' povedala Rivers autorky Yael Kohen v jej knihe 'We Killed: The Rise of Women in American Comedy'. 'Hovorila som o mojej mame, ktorá bola neúnavne zaujatá o to, aby si moja sestra a ja našli muža. Hovorila som o mojom gej priateľovi pánovi Phyllise, a o tom sa nehovorilo. Teraz to znie nevinné a hlúpo, ale môj vystup bol pre ženy, ktoré nemohli hovoriť.' Na začiatku Rivers chcela byť herečka a pracovala na dočasných pracovných miestach, kým sa snažila dosiahnuť svoj cieľ. Ale keď jej spolupracovníčka všimla, že v kancelárii vymyslíva stále vtipy, Rivers vyskúšala komédiu. 'Nemala som ani predstavu, čo robím,' pripomenula Rivers v článku z roku 2012 pre The Hollywood Reporter. 'Biali muži robili vtipy o teške a 'moja žena je tak tlustá...'. Keď som išla na pódiu, toto sa mi nezdalo správne. Tak som povedala: 'Povoďme o mojom živote.' Nebyla sama: George Carlin, Woody Allen a Bill Cosby — komikovia, ktorí vtedy rastli — tiež čerpali zo svojich osobných životov. Ale aj keď mali podobné intuície, Rivers sa stále nevešla. 'Nikdy som nebola jednou z chlapcov,' napísala Rivers v The Hollywood Reporter. 'Nikdy ma nezvali na stretnutie. Nikdy som o tom neuvažovala, až neskôr. Všetci šli do Stage Delicatessen, kde sa bavili. Ja som nikdy nedostala ísť hore a zjesť sendvič s nimi. Takže aj keď som bola s nimi, nebola som s nimi.' A možno to bolo lepšie. Po svojom prelomovom vystúpení na 'The Tonight Show' s Johnny Carsonom v roku 1965 sa Rivers vybudovala ako žena, ktorá otvorene a slobodne hovorila o tom, čo to znamená byť ženou. Ženské telo, jej sexuálny život, politika randení — nič nebolo zakázané. Nepovažovala za potrebné nič zmäkčiť. Vystúpenie v roku 1967 na 'The Ed Sullivan Show' môže teraz znieť zastarale s jeho odkazmi na samotný život, ale Riversina nespokojnosť s rozdielmi medzi mužmi a ženami je úprimne a dnes stále aktuálna. 'Dievča musí byť jasné, krásne, inteligentné, dobrý športovec — 'Howard Johnson’s znova, hurá, hurá!' Rivers sarkasticky imitovala, kým publiko hralo. 'To ma zabíja! Dievča, máte 30 rokov, ste nevydatá — ste stará panna. Muž, máte 90 rokov, ste neženatý — ste chyták. Je to úplne iná vec, nie?' Jej rozhovorový štýl ju urobil ideálnym výberom na vlastný talk-show program. Dokázala to ako Carsonova náhradníčka a častá hostia na 'Tonight'. Ako povedal jeden kritik z magazínu People, stala sa 'bitchy kráľovnou noci, ktorej humoristický zápal nechal stopy.' V roku 1986 Rivers spustila 'The Late Show Starring Joan Rivers' — prvé ženské talk-show v histórii noci. Aj keď trvalo len osem mesiacov, jej prítomnosť zničila dlhodobú prekážku v mužskom klube noci. 'Musíte byť mimoriadne silná, aniž by vás to videli,' povedala Rivers CNN v roku 2013. 'Ste majsterkou lvov. Musíte mať úplnú kontrolu — a pritom byť ženská, zábavná a zvedavá. Je to veľmi ťažké, a pre ženy je to ťažké, pretože nečakajú, že žena vezme kontrolu. Stále.' Ale berú. Od Chelsea Handler, ktorá ukončila úspešnú kariéru na E! a vytvorila niečo nové na Netflixe, cez Schumer, ktorá získala svoju prvú nomináciu na Emmy za svoj program na Comedy Central, po ikony ako Ellen DeGeneres a Whoopi Goldberg — ženy, ktoré nasledovali Rivers, neboli vždy tak kontroverzné, ale všetky majú jej neústupnú odhodlanosť. Kathy Griffin je pravdepodobne najjasnejším nástupcom Riversinej dedičstva. Ako Rivers, Griffin má talent presne zasiahnuť celebritu s úsmevom — zároveň sa seba kritizovať. Jej Emmy-víťazné reality show 'Kathy Griffin: My Life on the D-List' bola samokritickým prieskumom, ako Griffin sa snažila a zlyhávala pri stúpaní po Hollywoodskej rebríčku. Nie je ťažké si predstaviť, že keby Rivers bola narodená o pár desaťročí neskôr, urobila by podobný program. (Po všetkom, Rivers pracovala bez prestávky až do svojej smrti, hrajúc v reality show s dcérou Melissou a rado sa múčila celebritami na E!’s 'Fashion Police'.) V dokumente 'A Piece of Work' z roku 2010 sa Griffin o Rivers vyjadrovala: 'Podobne ako Phyllis Diller otvorila cestu pre ňu, ja by som toto nerobila, keby nebola pre mňa Joan.'
