article_content: The 2013-14 Ashes tour didn’t just end in humiliation—it shattered the unity of England’s cricket team. At the heart of the turmoil was Kevin Pietersen, whose long-simmering frustrations with team director Andy Flower exploded during a private players’ meeting in Melbourne. But Flower wasn’t the only target. Sources indicate Pietersen had also grown deeply critical of captain Alastair Cook’s leadership and vice-captain Matt Prior’s place in the side, voicing these views privately to teammates throughout the tour. He even dismissed batting coach Graham Gooch as ineffective. While some defend Pietersen, saying his critiques came from a place of genuine concern for the team’s future, others believe his actions were fueled by bitterness over losing the captaincy—and the coaching staff—in 2009. That wound never healed. After being reinstated following the 2012 Textgate scandal—thanks largely to Cook and Prior’s intervention—he repaid their trust with a century in Mumbai and helped secure a 3-0 win at home. But the fragile peace collapsed in Australia. When Pietersen seized control of a meeting meant to foster accountability, he pushed for Flower’s removal, alienating even those who had stood by him. His erratic batting—marked by high-risk shots and dismissals that frustrated legends like Geoff Boycott and David Gower—only deepened the divide. Meanwhile, media personality Piers Morgan stoked flames online, falsely claiming Prior had endorsed Pietersen’s rebellion by saying ‘F*** Flower.’ Prior denied it, clarifying his words were meant to shift blame away from management and onto the players themselves. Andrew Flintoff later challenged the narrative that Pietersen alone was to blame, arguing that the entire squad had failed to take ownership. ‘They’ve got one guy to take the fall,’ he said. ‘Where’s the collective responsibility?’ But senior figures, including new managing director Paul Downton, concluded Pietersen’s behavior went beyond criticism—it was an active campaign to undermine leadership. Even after his dismissal, Piers Morgan tried dragging Prior into the fray, further fracturing trust. Former colleague Mick Newell had warned years earlier: Pietersen’s brilliance was matched only by his capacity to disrupt. The timeline was off—but the outcome? Exactly as predicted.
translated_content: Turné Ashes v roku 2013–14 skončilo nie len hanbou, ale aj zničením jednoty anglického kriketového tímu. V srdci chaosu bol Kevin Pietersen, ktorého dlhodobé nespokojnosti s vedením tímu Andy Flowerom explodovali počas súkromného stretnutia hráčov v Melbourne. Ale Flower nebol jediným cieľom. Zdroje naznačujú, že Pietersen sa tiež hlboko kritizoval kapitána Alastaira Cooka a miesto náhradníka kapitána Mattha Priora, tieto názory vyjadroval súkromne medzi kolegami počas celej turné. Odmietal aj trénera úderov Graham Goocha ako neúčinného. Niektorí bránia Pietersena, hovoriac, že jeho kritika vychádzala z skutočnej starostlivosti o budúcnosť tímu, iní veria, že jeho konanie bolo poháňané hnevom z straty kapitánskej funkcie a trénerskej zložky v roku 2009. Tá rana sa nikdy nezahojila. Po tom, čo bol znovu začlenený po skandále Textgate v roku 2012 – vďaka zásahu Cooka a Priora – odplatil ich dôveru skórom v Mumbai a pomohol dosiahnuť víťazstvo 3:0 doma. Ale krehký mier sa zlomil v Austrálii. Keď Pietersen prevzal kontrolu nad stretnutím, ktoré malo podporovať zodpovednosť, požadoval odstránenie Flowera, čím znechutil aj tých, čo ho doteraz podporovali. Jeho chaotický štýl úderov – s vysokorizikovými údermi a vypadnutiami, ktoré frustrovali legendy ako Geoff Boycott a David Gower – iba zhoršil rozdelenie. Súčasne médiá a osobnosť Piers Morgan ohrievali napätie online, falošne tvrdiac, že Prior podporil Pietersenovu vzpouru výrokmi „F*** Flower“. Prior to poprel, zdôrazňujúc, že jeho slová mali zmysel posunúť vinu od manažmentu na hráčov. Andrew Flintoff neskôr vyvolal diskusiu o tom, či je Pietersen jediným viníkom, argumentujúc, že celý tím zlyhal pri preberaní zodpovednosti. „Majú jedného chlapa, ktorý má brať vinu,“ povedal. „Kde je spoločná zodpovednosť?“ Ale vysoké funkcionáre vrátane nového riaditeľa Paula Downtona dospeli k záveru, že Pietersenovo správanie prekračovalo kritiku – bolo aktívnym pokusom podkopávať vedenie. Aj po jeho vylúčení sa Piers Morgan pokúsil zapojiť Priora do sporu, čím ešte viac poškodil dôveru. article_content: Doctors investigating the death of Dr. David Kelly have written to the Chief Coroner, urging the resumption of his inquest and a re-examination of the suicide verdict. In a letter addressed to Judge Peter Thornton QC, they highlighted significant deficiencies in the legal process: the inquest was never formally closed, no final death certificate was issued, and no coroner officially confirmed the cause of death. They also noted that the first police officer on the scene altered his account of how the body was positioned—raising questions about whether it had been moved. Dr. Kelly, a government scientist, was found dead near his Oxfordshire home in July 2003, shortly after being named as the source of a BBC report on Iraq’s alleged weapons of mass destruction. Led by radiologist Dr. Stephen Frost, the group has long advocated for a full public inquiry. They argue that the Hutton Inquiry, which effectively replaced the work of Oxfordshire Coroner Nicholas Gardiner, was fundamentally inadequate. They contend that Lord Hutton relied uncritically on a single pathologist’s opinion, lacked formal legal authority to determine cause of death, and failed to conduct a rigorous investigation. In their letter, copied to the Lord Chief Justice, the Lord Chancellor, and the Oxfordshire coroner, they insist that any reasonable person would recognize the need to reopen the case. They call for a new inquest with sworn testimony before a jury, the summoning of relevant Thames Valley Police officers, and full access to all materials reviewed—or withheld—by the Hutton Inquiry. The doctors demand that the suicide verdict be proven beyond all doubt, with a proper certification of cause of death and formal closure of proceedings. Although Attorney General Dominic Grieve rejected calls to reopen the case in 2011, citing no reasonable prospect of a different outcome, the doctors maintain that new evidence and procedural failures warrant urgent reconsideration.

V liste adresovanom sudcovi Peterovi Thorntonovi QC zdôraznili významné nedostatky v právnom procese: prešetrenie nebolo nikdy formálne uzavreté, nebol vydaný žiadny konečný úmrtný list a žiadny koronér neoznámil oficiálnu príčinu smrti. Dr. Kelly, vládny vedec, bol nájdený mŕtvy blízko svojho domova v Oksfordshíre v júli 2003, krátko po tom, ako bol identifikovaný ako zdroj správy BBC o irackých tzv. zbraniach hromadného ničenia. article_content: Ronnie O’Sullivan sealed a stunning 6-0 victory over Matthew Selt in the fourth round of the Coral UK Championship, capping the match with a brilliant 147 maximum break. The feat, the 109th in professional snooker history and the 13th of O’Sullivan’s career, extended his own all-time record. Despite playing on a broken left ankle—sustained during a run in Essex last week—he delivered a masterclass, including four half-century breaks alongside the perfect clearance. The final blue wobbled precariously in the jaws of the middle pocket before dropping, sparking a moment of tension before the crowd erupted in applause. For the break, O’Sullivan earned £44,000—the first maximum of the tournament. His performance moved him into the quarter-finals, where he will face Anthony McGill as he continues his quest for a fifth UK Championship title and his first since 2007. Meanwhile, Marco Fu edged out Shaun Murphy 6-5 in a nail-biting decider, potting all the colours after Murphy snookered himself on the final yellow. Judd Trump also advanced, defeating Rod Lawler 6-3 with two century breaks, setting up a quarter-final clash with Mark Davis.

article_content: High above the grounds of Eastnor Castle in Herefordshire, two of Britain’s top slackliners are preparing for an extraordinary challenge — crossing a 60-foot line suspended 100 feet in the air between two castle turrets. This daring feat, never before attempted at the historic site, will be broadcast live on ITV’s new game show, 'Red or Black'. Phil Baxter, 24, from Lancashire, and Allen Freem, 20, from South Wales, are no strangers to extreme heights. Both are elite rock climbers with years of experience, making them ideal candidates for the stunt. Their coach, Russ Holbert, 36, director of the UK’s leading slacklining team, was approached by ITV to select the most capable performers. 'They needed people who could handle the pressure — physically and mentally,' Holbert explains. Unlike a rigid tightrope, slacklines stretch and sway like trampolines, demanding constant micro-adjustments. For two full days, Phil and Allen practiced under controlled conditions. But nothing could replicate the intensity of performing live, with thousands watching and millions more tuning in. Contestants on 'Red or Black' must guess which athlete will reach the other side first — betting on their speed and stability. The winner takes home £1 million. As the moment arrived, even presenters Ant and Dec were stunned. 'The crowd was screaming, jumping — it felt like a live concert,' Holbert recalls. While this stunt pushes the limits of the sport, slacklining itself is becoming increasingly popular across the UK. Local clubs welcome beginners with low-level lines, turning balance and focus into fun, accessible fitness. For many, this televised spectacle is the spark that leads to a lifelong passion — proving that adrenaline isn’t just for thrill-seekers, but for anyone willing to step onto the line.

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) — A U.S. government report reveals that more than one-third of the weapons supplied by the United States to Afghanistan’s government are unaccounted for. According to the U.S. Government Accountability Office (GAO), the military failed to maintain complete inventory records for an estimated 87,000 of the 242,000 small arms and light weapons procured and shipped to Afghanistan between December 2004 and June 2008 — roughly 36% of the total. The Defense Department spent approximately $120 million during this period acquiring rifles, machine guns, and rocket-propelled grenade launchers for the Afghan National Security Forces. Additionally, another 135,000 weapons acquired from 21 other countries were never properly tracked. For 46,000 of the missing weapons, no serial numbers were recorded. For the remaining 41,000, there is no documentation of their location or fate. Rep. John Tierney, D-Massachusetts, chair of the House Subcommittee on National Security and Foreign Affairs, warned during a congressional hearing: 'What if we had to tell families of U.S. soldiers not only why we are in Afghanistan, but why their son or daughter died at the hands of an insurgent using a weapon purchased by U.S. taxpayers? That’s the risk if tens of thousands of our weapons are circulating off the books.' The GAO report urges Defense Secretary Robert Gates to establish clear accountability procedures — including mandatory serial-number tracking and regular physical inventories — for all weapons under U.S. control. This revelation comes as security in Afghanistan continues to deteriorate. On Wednesday, eight Taliban suicide attackers struck government buildings and a prison in Kabul, killing at least 19 people — an assault the Taliban claimed was retaliation for prisoner abuse, according to Afghan officials. The incident raises fresh doubts about the effectiveness of the $16.5 billion U.S. effort to train and equip Afghan forces. Meanwhile, the Obama administration is reviewing its entire strategy for Afghanistan and Pakistan, with a decision on additional troop deployments expected imminently. Officials plan to seek $5.7 billion in additional aid for Afghan security forces in fiscal year 2009.

Podľa Úradu pre zodpovednosť vlády USA (GAO) armáda nevedela vedieť úplné inventárne záznamy pre odhadovaných 87 000 z 242 000 malých zbraní a ľahkých zbraní zakúpených a dovezených do Afganistanu medzi decembrom 2004 a júnom 2008 — približne 36 % celkového počtu. Ministerstvo obrany vynaložilo počas tohto obdobia približne 120 miliónov dolárov na nákup pušiek, kulometov a rakietových odpalovačov pre áfganské bezpečnostné sily. Navyše ďalších 135 000 zbraní zakúpených od 21 iných krajín nebolo nikdy správne sledovaných. Pre 46 000 z chýbajúcich zbraní neboli zaznamenané sériové čísla. Pre zvyšných 41 000 neexistujú žiadne dokumenty o ich lokalite alebo osude. Predsedajúci Podvýboru pre národnú bezpečnosť a zahraničnú politiku Snemovne reprezentantov John Tierney, D-Massachusetts, varoval počas zasadnutia Kongresu: 'Čo ak by sme museli povedať rodinám amerických vojakov nie len prečo sme v Afganistane, ale aj prečo ich syn alebo dcéra zomreli v rukách povstalcov používajúcich zbraň zakúpenú daňovými poplatníkmi USA? To je riziko, ak desiatky tisíc našich zbraní cirkuluje mimo účtovníctva.' Správa GAO vyžaduje od ministra obrany Roberta Gatesa, aby stanovil jasné postupy zodpovednosti — vrátane povinného sledovania podľa sériového čísla a pravidelných fyzických inventúr — pre všetky zbrane pod americkou kontrolou. Tento objav nastal v čase, keď sa bezpečnostná situácia v Afganistane ďalej zhoršuje. V stredu osem samovrážedných útočníkov z Talibánu zaútočilo na vládne budovy a väzenie v Kabule, zabili najmenej 19 ľudí — útok, ktorý Talibán tvrdil, že je odpoveďou na zneužívanie väzňov, podľa áfganských úradov. Tento incident vyvoláva nové pochybnosti o účinnosti 16,5-miliardovej snahy USA na výcvik a vybavenie áfganských síl. Súčasne administratíva Obamy prehliadkuje celú stratégiu voči Afganistanu a susednému Pakistánu, pričom rozhodnutie o poslaní ďalších vojsk sa očakáva v priebehu najbližších dní. Úradníci plánujú požiadať o ďalších 5,7 miliardy dolárov na pomoc áfganskym bezpečnostným silám v finančnom roku 2009.

article_content: In May 2013, Florida man Francis Riccio, 45, was arrested in Brooklyn, New York, for the first-degree murder of his 70-year-old mother, Maureen Riccio. Authorities state that Riccio killed his mother during a violent argument triggered by stress over her medical conditions. He subsequently dismembered her body, placed the remains in garbage bags, and scattered them in wooded areas south of their home in Melbourne, Florida. After cleaning the house, painting a bedroom, selling his truck, and withdrawing his children from school, Riccio and his long-term girlfriend relocated approximately 1,000 miles to Brooklyn, telling friends and neighbors that a family member had passed away. While authorities believe his two teenage children and 10-year-old child were unaware of the murder, police suspect they may have been present during the attack. The investigation began on May 14, 2013, when an electrical technician discovered human remains beside a road in Micco, Florida. Over the next two weeks, investigators from the Brevard County Sheriff’s Office and the New York City Police Department recovered the full remains of Maureen Riccio. Riccio had also been under prior investigation by NYPD for allegedly selling stolen goods on Craigslist. Neighbors reported growing tension in the household after Riccio failed to secure a nursing facility for his mother. One neighbor recounted Riccio describing his mother as 'kind of schizophrenic' and expressing intentions to send her back north. Maj. Tod Goodyear of the Brevard County Sheriff’s Office acknowledged the challenges of caring for aging parents but emphasized that violence is never justified. Riccio remains in custody without bond and is scheduled to be transferred to Brevard County for trial. His girlfriend has not been charged.

Úradníci uvádzajú, že Riccio zabil svoju matku počas násilného sporu vyvolaného stresom spôsobeným jej zdravotnými problémami. article_content: At least 50 officers and civilians were killed after a violent mutiny by Bangladeshi paramilitary troops, the country’s law minister confirmed Thursday. The uprising, led by low-ranking members of the Bangladesh Rifles (BDR), took place at the organization’s headquarters in Dhaka during BDR Week — a time when thousands of troops were gathered for celebrations. For more than 12 hours, the mutineers held senior officers hostage amid intense gunfire, leaving streets near the compound littered with debris and plumes of smoke visible across the city. Civilians, including a rickshaw puller, were among the dead, struck by stray bullets during the chaos. As night fell, the government responded by offering amnesty to the rebels. Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina’s pledge prompted the mutineers to begin surrendering their weapons. Video footage broadcast on national television showed Home Minister Sahara Kahtun addressing the troops directly, assuring them their grievances would be heard. Officers laid down rifles and ammunition in response. According to Mohammed Sajjad Haider, spokesperson for the information ministry, the mutineers demanded pay parity with the regular army, improved food rations, and greater job security. Their mobile phones had been disabled, complicating the government’s efforts to assess the situation. The mutiny is the most severe challenge yet faced by Bangladesh’s democratically elected government, which took office in December after two years of military-backed rule. Onlookers gathered outside the compound throughout the day, often scattering at the sound of gunfire. One resident of San Diego, visiting family in Dhaka, described the experience as 'very rattling,' with helicopters circling overhead and sporadic bursts of gunfire echoing through the neighborhood.

Vzbury, ktoré viedli nižšie hodnosti Bangladéšskej stráže (BDR), sa odohrali na sídle organizácie v Dháke počas Týždňa BDR – času, keď bolo zhromaždených tisíce vojakov na oslavách. Medzi mŕtvymi boli aj civilisti, vrátane vozíkara, ktorých zasiahli náhodné strely počas chaosu. Keď nastala noc, vláda reagovala ponukou amnestie pre povstalcov. article_content: NBC has signed Bill Cosby for a new sitcom. The 76-year-old comedian is slated to play the patriarch of a multigenerational family, according to a network representative who spoke to CNN on Wednesday. The network did not provide further details about the show. NBC is likely hoping this version of Cosby evokes memories of his eight-year run as the warm-hearted yet firm Dr. Cliff Huxtable on 'The Cosby Show'—and not the short-lived detective series 'The Cosby Mysteries' (1994–95) or the declining ratings of 'Cosby' (1996–2000), which began strongly but faded quickly. Cosby’s return coincides with other 1980s and early 1990s icons making comebacks: Michael J. Fox has starred in 'The Michael J. Fox Show' since September, and Bob Saget, Dave Coulier, and John Stamos are reuniting for a Super Bowl yogurt commercial. (No word yet on the Olsen twins.) Nostalgia and Q-scores—popularity metrics favored by marketers—have limits. Cosby remains a widely liked figure; many still hold fond memories of him, even though it’s been decades since he was TV’s top pitchman. (He is inducted into the Advertising Hall of Fame.) 'The Cosby Show' was a landmark in American television, showcasing a prosperous African American family and topping the ratings for five straight years in the 1980s. NBC’s dominance in prime time began with its success. 'Bill Cosby is always going to be welcomed into people's homes because of nostalgia for the Huxtables,' says Amanda McClain, a communications professor at Holy Family University in Philadelphia. But the real challenge lies in the show itself. As Time’s James Poniewozik noted, 'A famous name is itself no guarantee.' Fox’s show, for example, struggled because it relied too heavily on past fame rather than compelling storytelling. 'Bill Cosby, like the Jell-O he once pitched, remains a beloved brand. But if his show makes it to air, the proof will be not in the brand but in the pudding.' Television has never been fully reflective of reality, McClain adds. While 1970s shows like 'Good Times' and 'Sanford & Son' portrayed diverse, working-class lives, modern sitcoms have largely retreated into aspirational, upper-middle-class narratives. Even 'The Cosby Show' was more idealized than realistic—a wealthy doctor and lawyer living in Brooklyn Heights. John Griffiths, president of the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association and TV critic for Us Weekly, argues that Hollywood’s writing rooms remain dominated by white, affluent men—many Ivy League-educated and living in West Los Angeles—limiting authentic representation. 'The networks try hard to hire diverse writing staffs,' he says, 'but the voices shaping the stories often don’t reflect the audiences they claim to serve.' Attempts to diversify have struggled: 'The New Normal,' featuring a same-sex couple and surrogate, was canceled after one season; 'The Middle,' about a working-class Indiana family, continues quietly, underrated by critics. Cable networks like HBO have taken bolder risks—with shows like 'Getting On,' set in a nursing home and featuring a closeted gay man and an African American nurse—which Griffiths calls 'almost like a Norman Lear show.' With baby boomers becoming caregivers for aging parents—the so-called 'sandwich generation'—a sitcom centered on multigenerational elder care could resonate. 'The aged are very underrepresented,' Griffiths notes. 'If Cosby’s new show embraces that, it could spark a trend.' Ultimately, television remains a shared family experience, McClain says: 'Families watch TV together—even now, with DVRs and second screens.'

Sieť neuviedla ďalšie podrobnosti o show. NBC pravdepodobne dúfa, že táto verzia Cosbyho vybude spomienky na jeho osemročný beh ako teplý, ale pevný doktor Cliff Huxtable v 'The Cosby Show' — a nie na krátkodobý detektívsky seriál 'The Cosby Mysteries' (1994–95) alebo na pokles hodnotení 'Cosby' (1996–2000), ktorý začal silne, ale rýchlo upadol. Návrat Cosbyho sa zhoduje s návratmi iných ikon z 80. a začiatku 90. rokov: Michael J. Fox hral v 'The Michael J. Fox Show' od septembra, a Bob Saget, Dave Coulier a John Stamos sa spoja pre reklamu jogurtu počas Super Bowlu. (Zatiaľ žiadne informácie o Olsenových dvojičkách.) Spomienky a Q-skóre — meracie ukazovatele obľúbenosti, ktoré majú marketingoví odborníci rád — majú svoje limity. Cosby zostáva obľúbenou osobnosťou; mnohí si ešte uchovávajú teplé pocity k nemu, aj keď už desaťročia nepôsobil ako najobľúbenejší reklamný tvár. (Je členom Sály slávy reklamy.) 'The Cosby Show' bol významným dielom amerického televízneho vysielania, ktoré predstavovalo úspešnú afroamerickú rodinu a v 80. rokoch bol najvyššie hodnotený počas piatich rokov po sebe. Dominancia NBC v prime time začala práve jeho úspechom. 'Bill Cosby je vždy vítaný do domov ľudí kvôli spomienkam na Huxtables,' hovorí Amanda McClain, profesorka komunikácie na Holy Family University v Philadelphii. Ale skutočný výzov leží v samotnej show. Ako poznamenal James Poniewozik z Time, 'Slávne meno samo osebe nie je zárukou.' Ale ak sa jeho show dostane na televíziu, dôkaz nebude v brande, ale v kaši.' Televízia nikdy nebola úplne odzrkadlením reality, pripomína McClain. Zatiaľ čo seriály z 70. rokov ako 'Good Times' a 'Sanford & Son' zobrazovali rôznorodé, pracujúce triedy, moderné sitcomy sa v podstate vrátili k aspiratívnym, vyššie strednej triedy príbehom. Dokonca aj 'The Cosby Show' bola viac idealizovaná ako realistická — bohatý lekár a právnik žijúci v Brooklyn Heights. John Griffiths, predseda Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association a televízny kritik pre Us Weekly, tvrdí, že písateľské miestnosti Hollywoodu zostávajú dominované bielymi, bohatými mužmi — mnohí absolventi Ivy League a bývajúci na západnej strane Los Angeles — čo obmedzuje autentickú reprezentáciu. 'Siete sa snažia najmať rôznorodé písateľské tímy,' hovorí, 'ale hlasy, ktoré tvarujú príbehy, často neodzrkadľujú publika, ktoré tvrdia, že slúžia.' Pokusy o rozšírenie diverzity sa sťažili: 'The New Normal', ktorý predstavoval rovnakopohlavný pár a surrogát, bol zrušený po jednej sezóne; 'The Middle', o pracujúcej triede v Indiane, pokračuje ticho, podceňovaný kritikmi. Káblové siete ako HBO prebrali odvážnejšie riziká — s ukážkami ako 'Getting On', ktorý je nastavený v domovej starostlivosti a obsahuje skrytého geja a afroamerickú sestru — ktoré Griffiths nazýva 'skoro ako Norman Lear show.' S baby boomermi, ktorí sa stávajú starostlivcami pre starších rodičov — takzvanou 'sandwich generáciou' — môže sitcom zameraný na viacgeneračnú starostlivosť zaznieť. 'Starší ľudia sú veľmi podreprezentovaní,' poznamenáva Griffiths. 'Ak Cosbyho nová show prijme to, môže spustiť trend.' V konečnom dôsledku sa televízia stáva spoločnou rodinnou skúsenosťou, hovorí McClain: 'Rodiny sledujú televíziu spolu — aj teraz, s DVR a druhými obrazovkami.'

article_content: Two young men, Craig Jewell, 21, and Josh Tate, 18, were killed in a devastating high-speed crash in Bournemouth, Dorset, early on Saturday morning. Their black Vauxhall Vectra lost control on the northbound A348 Ringwood Road in the Bear Cross district, veered off the road, and slammed into a tree just before a roundabout. The force of the impact completely destroyed the center of the vehicle, severed a tree trunk in half, and triggered a massive fireball that engulfed the wreckage. Residents in nearby homes awoke around 4:30 a.m. to a loud crash followed by a deafening roar as flames shot up to 35 feet, lighting up the night sky. Neighbors immediately called 999, alerting police, paramedics, and firefighters. Emergency crews arrived swiftly and worked for hours to recover the victims, using a large tarpaulin screen to shield the scene. Both men died at the scene from catastrophic injuries. The road was closed in both directions for 12 hours following the collision. Police believe the pair were returning home after a night out. No other vehicles were involved. Chief Inspector Steve White of Dorset Police confirmed the crash occurred at approximately 4:45 a.m. and stated the car caught fire upon impact. One witness described hearing two distinct sounds — the crash and then a violent explosion — and reported seeing pieces of the car scattered across the road and nearby gardens, including windscreen wipers and body panels. Authorities have not determined the exact cause but suspect excessive speed or driver fatigue. The investigation remains open, and police are appealing for additional witnesses.

Ich čierny Vauxhall Vectra stratil kontrolu na severnom smerovaní cesty A348 Ringwood Road v oblasti Bear Cross, vyjazdil z cesty a zrazil sa do stromu hneď pred kruhovým objazdom. article_content: In the remote village of Benito Juarez in Tabasco, southeastern Mexico, residents killed a 25-foot snake they believed posed a lethal threat to children and livestock. The massive reptile — likely a green anaconda, one of the world’s largest snake species — was spotted lying beside a railway track, prompting rail passengers to alert locals. Armed with sticks and a machete, villagers pursued the snake as it tried to retreat into the underbrush and beat it to death, later severing its head. Conservationists have strongly criticized the killing, warning that those involved may face legal charges under Mexico’s wildlife protection laws. However, villagers remain unapologetic. 'I’ve never seen a snake that big — it was clearly a danger to people and animals,' said local resident Nicandro Aguilar. 'It could have swallowed a child as easily as a lamb.' Some residents had previously blamed eagles for the disappearances of young livestock, but suspected the snake had been lurking in a nearby cave. The carcass was only discovered when villagers laid it on a bridge, preparing to remove its skin — a scene captured by a passing tourist who took photographs.

Obrovský plaz — pravdepodobne zelená anakonda, jedna z najväčších druhov hadov na svete — bol zaznamenaný ležiaci po boku železničnej trate, čo nútilo cestujúcich vo vlaku upozorniť miestnych. Niektorí obyvatelia predtým podozrievali orlov zo zmiznutím mladého dobytka, ale podozrievali, že had sa skrýva v blízkej jaskyni. article_content: This month, as Europe’s top football nations prepare for Euro 2012, many star players will be sidelined — not by tactical choices, but by exhaustion. The English Premier League, uniquely without a winter break, pushes athletes harder than any other major European league. According to UEFA, EPL players are four times more likely to suffer injuries in the final stretch of the season compared to their peers elsewhere. With packed schedules and relentless physical demands, burnout seems almost unavoidable — but what if it didn’t have to be? Dr. Craig Duncan, a leading sports scientist based in Australia and head of human performance at Sydney FC, believes the answer lies in wearable GPS technology. These small devices, roughly half the size of a smartphone, can track every sprint, turn, and stride a player makes during a match. By measuring workload intensity in real time, coaches could identify when a player is approaching dangerous fatigue levels — and sub them out before injury strikes. GPS systems are already widely used in training across top clubs and are standard in Australian rugby, rugby union, and Australian Rules football. Yet FIFA still classifies them as non-essential gear for matchday — even though clubs use them daily behind the scenes. Duncan argues this is short-sighted. With FIFA having just committed $75 million to an insurance fund that pays clubs up to $27,000 per day per injured player, there’s clear financial logic to preventing injuries in the first place. At Sydney FC, Duncan says injury rates have dropped by over 60% since introducing GPS monitoring in training. He’s confident that allowing it during matches could cut even more fatigue-related injuries. But not everyone agrees. Darren Burgess, fitness chief at Liverpool, doubts coaches would ever pull a player solely based on GPS data, citing reliability concerns in large stadiums like Anfield where signals might be disrupted. Still, the broader picture suggests a crisis: Raymond Verheijen, working with Russia’s national team, claims up to 80% of injuries stem from chronic fatigue. His analysis of 27,000 matches shows teams with only two days’ rest between games are drastically less likely to win — especially when facing opponents with three full days to recover. Beyond physical strain, experts like Simon Shepard of Optima-Life stress that modern athletes face pressures far beyond training: travel, media obligations, social stress, and sleep deprivation. True player care, he says, means supporting them for all 168 hours of the week — not just the 20 spent on the pitch. And yet, despite multi-billion-dollar wage bills, less than 1% of EPL clubs’ budgets go toward sports science and injury prevention. Duncan calls it absurd: 'People spend more maintaining a $30,000 car.' Interestingly, FIFA’s own rulebook doesn’t outright ban GPS — it simply requires that any non-standard equipment must be safe and for protection. That loophole, some argue, could open the door to legalizing GPS on matchdays — if clubs dare to ask.

Anglická Premier liga, jediná z hlavných európskych súťaží bez zimnej prestávky, tlačí športovcov tvrdšie ako akákoľvek iná európska súťaž. Podľa UEFA sú hráči EPL štyrikrát častejšie zranení v posledných mesiacoch sezóny oproti svojim kolegom inde. Pri plnom rozvrhu a neustálom fyzickom zaťažení je vyčerpanie takmer nevyhnutné — ale čo ak sa nemusí stať? Dr. Craig Duncan, vedec zo športovej vedy z Austrálie a riaditeľ ľudského výkonu v Sydney FC, verí, že riešením sú nositeľné GPS zariadenia. Tieto malé zariadenia, približne polovičnej veľkosti ako mobilný telefón, môžu sledovať každý skok, obrat a krok hráča počas zápasu. Pomocou merania intenzity zaťaženia v reálnom čase by tréneri mohli identifikovať, kedy hráč prichádza k nebezpečnej úrovni únavy — a vymeniť ho pred tým, než dojde k zraneniu. GPS systémy už sú široko používané v tréningoch najvyšších klubov a sú štandardom v austrálskom ragby, ragby union a austrálskom futbale. Avšak FIFA ich stále považuje za neštandardné vybavenie pre deň zápasu — aj keď kluby ich používajú každý deň za scenármi. Duncan tvrdí, že toto je krátkozraké. Keďže FIFA práve zaviedla poisťovací fond vo výške 75 miliónov dolárov, ktorý vypláca klubom až 27 000 dolárov denne za každého zraneného hráča, existuje jasná finančná logika zabrániť zraneniam vopred. V Sydney FC Duncan hovorí, že počet zranení klesol o viac ako 60 % od zavedenia monitorovania zaťaženia pomocou GPS. Je presvedčený, že povolenie jeho použitia počas zápasov by mohlo znížiť ešte viac únava-spôsobených zranení. Ale nie všetci sú s ním súhlasi. Darren Burgess, riaditeľ kondície v Liverpoole, pochybuje, či by tréneri niekedy vymienili hráča iba na základe údajov z GPS, citujúc obavy o spoľahlivosť v veľkých štadiónoch ako Anfield, kde by mohol byť signál rušený. Aj tak, širší obraz naznačuje krízu: Raymond Verheijen, ktorý pracuje s národným tímom Ruska, tvrdí, že až 80 % zranení vzniká z chronického vyčerpania. Jeho analýza 27 000 zápasov ukazuje, že tímy s iba dvoma dňami odpočinku medzi zápasmi sú výrazne menej pravdepodobné, že vyhrajú — najmä keď stojí proti súperom s tromi plnými dňami na obnovu. Okrem fyzického zaťaženia odborníci ako Simon Shepard z Optima-Life zdôrazňujú, že moderní športovci čelia tlaku mimo tréningu: cestovaniu, médiám, sociálnemu stresu a nedostatku spánku. Pravým podporovaním hráča, hovorí, je pomáhať im počas všetkých 168 hodín týždňa — nie len počas 20 hodín na ihrisku. A napriek viac-miliardovým platovým bilanciam menej ako 1 % rozpočtu klubov EPL ide na športovú vedu a prevenciu zranení. Duncan to považuje za absurdné: „Ľudia strácajú viac na údržbe auta za 30 000 dolárov.“ Zaujímavé je, že samotné pravidlá FIFA nezakazujú GPS — vyžadujú len, aby akékoľvek neštandardné vybavenie bolo bezpečné a slúžilo na ochranu. Táto dieravosť, tvrdia niektorí, by mohla otvoriť cestu k legálnemu použitiu GPS počas zápasov — ak kluby budú odvážne požiadať.

article_content: Microsoft's revenue has been growing—slowly, but steadily. Profits have grown even faster, as the company tightens its spending. Its core software, such as Office 2010, has delivered strong results for over a year, and the Xbox had its best holiday season ever, selling one million units in a single day after Thanksgiving. The company also holds more than $50 billion in cash. So why has its stock remained stagnant for nearly a decade? And why do major investors continue to call for CEO Steve Ballmer’s resignation? The issue boils down to a startling statistic: five years ago, 95% of internet-connected devices ran Windows PCs. Today, that figure has fallen below 80%, and some analysts predict it could drop below 20% within a few years. This represents a historic shift—one of many signs that the personal computer is no longer the dominant force in consumer technology. The surge in smartphones, led by Apple’s iPhone and a wide array of Android-powered devices, has driven this change. Android now outsells the iPhone in unit volume. Apple’s iPad, less than two years old at the time of reporting, has captured roughly 10% of the traditional PC market. Microsoft has been absent from both the smartphone and tablet markets—until now. This year, it aims to change everything. Next month, Microsoft will release a preview version of Windows 8, which Ballmer has called the most important product in the company’s history. Windows 8 is designed to be dual-purpose: it features a modern, touch-optimized interface for tablets—with vibrant tiles, swipe gestures, and an app store reminiscent of iOS—while retaining the familiar desktop environment for traditional PCs. Users on tablets will likely interact mostly with the new interface; office workers on laptops and desktops will stick with the classic view. But the transition isn’t seamless. It remains unclear how smoothly users can switch between the two modes—or whether the full desktop experience will even be available on ARM-based tablets, like those powered by Apple’s chips. Historically, Microsoft has compensated for product uncertainty with massive marketing campaigns. Expect hundreds of millions spent on TV ads, influencer outreach, and co-marketing deals with hardware partners and enterprise resellers. Windows 8 is only half the story. Microsoft launched Windows Phone in late 2010—an operating system that, in some respects, outperformed the iPhone at launch. Yet poor hardware choices, lack of carrier support (especially from Verizon), and a weak app ecosystem caused it to fail. A year later, Windows Phone held less than 2% market share, far behind iOS, Android, and even BlackBerry. This year, Microsoft has partnered with Nokia, the world’s largest mobile manufacturer, to launch a new line of Windows Phones. The flagship Lumia 900 has earned near-universal acclaim—comparable to the early iPhone reviews. Crucially, Microsoft is investing heavily in retail promotion, including commission incentives for store employees who previously didn’t know what a Windows Phone was. Windows 8 and Windows Phone. Microsoft is pushing both like its future depends on them—because it does.
translated_content: Príjem Microsoftu rastie — pomaly, ale rastie. Zisky rastú rýchlejšie ako príjmy, pretože spoločnosť znižuje výdavky. Jej základný softvér, ako je Office 2010, ukazuje skvelé výsledky už viac ako rok, a Xbox mal svoju najlepšiu dobu vianočného obdobia, keď Microsoft predal milión jednotiek za jeden deň po Šťastnom dňe. Navyše má viac ako 50 miliárd dolárov v hotovosti. Prečo teda jeho akcie odmietajú pohnúť sa po posledných desať rokov? Prečo veľkí investori stále volajú po odchode generálneho riaditeľa Steva Ballmera? Problém sa zvyšuje na jednoduchom štatistickom údaji, ktorý by mal vystrašiť Microsoft a jeho investora: Pred piatimi rokmi bolo 95 % zariadení pripojených k internetu Windows PC. Teraz je ich menej ako 80 % a niektorí odborníci očakávajú, že číslo klesne pod 20 % za pár rokov. Ide o historický posun — jeden z mnohých signálov, že osobný počítač už nie je dominantný v neustále sa meniacom svete spotrebitelskej technológie. Výbuch chytrých telefónov, ktoré viedol Apple iPhone a široký výber zariadení s Androidom, toto zmenil. Android teraz predáva viac jednotiek ako iPhone. Apple iPad, ktorý je ešte menej ako dva roky starý, získal približne 10 % trhu so stolovými počítačmi. Microsoft bol mimo trhu chytrých telefónov aj tabletov — až do teraz. V tomto roku sa snaží všetko zmeniť. Nasledujúci mesiac spoločnosť uvoľní predverziu systému Windows 8, ktorú Ballmer označil za najdôležitejší produkt v histórii spoločnosti. Windows 8 je navrhnutý ako dvojúčelový systém: na povrchu má moderné, dotykové rozhranie určené pre tablety — s jasnými dlaždicami, posúvacími obrazovkami a obchodom s aplikáciami, ktorý pripomína iOS — zároveň však zachováva známe prostredie pre tradičné počítače. Používatelia tabletov budú väčšinou pracovať s novým rozhraním, zatiaľ čo pracovníci na notebookoch a stolových počítačoch budú pokračovať v používaní klasického rozhrania. Ale prechod nie je úplne hladký. Nie je úplne jasné, ako plynule sa bude dať prepínať medzi oboma režimami, alebo či sa bude môcť používať klasické prostredie Windows na tabletových zariadeniach s ARM procesormi, ktoré používajú napríklad iPad. Historicky Microsoft kompenzoval neistoty vývoja obrovskými marketingovými kampaniami. Očakávajte, že spoločnosť minie stovky miliónov dolárov na televíznych reklamách, viralových kampaniach a spoločných marketingových programoch s partnermi na hardvér a distribútormi pre veľké firmy. Windows 8 je len polovicou rovnice. Microsoft už v jeseni 2010 predstavil prekvapivo dobrú platformu pre chytré telefóny — v niektorých ohľadoch bola lepšia ako iPhone od samého začiatku. Avšak kvôli slabšiemu hardvéru, nedostatočnej podpore operátorov ako Verizon a chýbajúcim aplikáciám zlyhala. O rok neskôr mal systém Windows Phone podiel trhu menej ako 2 %, výrazne za iOS, Androidom a dokonca aj oslabeným BlackBerry. Tento rok sa Microsoft spojil s Nokiom, najväčším výrobcou mobilných zariadení na svete, aby vyvinul nový rad telefónov s Windows Phone. Ich flagship model Lumia 900 dostal všeobecne vynikajúce recenzie — podobné tým, ktoré dostal iPhone pri svojom úvodnom vydanií. Rozhodujúce je, že Microsoft investuje stovky miliónov dolárov do marketingu týchto telefónov vrátane provízií pre predavačov v obchodoch. To je kritické, pretože minulý rok mnoho predavačov vôbec nevedelo, čo je Windows Phone. Windows 8. Windows Phone. Očakávajte, že Microsoft bude tieto produkty propagovať tak, ako keby na nich závisela jeho budúcnosť. Pretože áno.

article_content: Best-selling Scottish author Ian Rankin has criticized Edinburgh Airport’s security procedures after being caught in a lengthy queue with other frustrated travelers. The 54-year-old author of the Inspector Rebus series expressed his frustration on Twitter, complaining about the airport’s airlock system and noting that only one X-ray machine was operational at 7:30 a.m. In a tweet addressed to @EDI_Airport and his 80,000 followers, he wrote: 'Hey, @EDI_Airport, one X-ray machine in use at 7:30 a.m.? Having to lock passengers out because you're overrun? Embarrassing.' Edinburgh Airport is currently trialing a new £25 million security hall alongside its existing facility, using an 'airlock system' to manage passenger flow between the two zones safely. Approximately 30 minutes after Rankin’s tweet, the airport responded, denying that passengers were being locked out: 'We're currently testing our new security hall and running two halls. We have an airlock process so we can do that safely. We're not locking anyone out.' Rankin replied: 'Thanks for replying. Top of escalator, doors on left leading to security were locked. Passengers milling. Not a lockout?' Other passengers and Edinburgh West MP Mike Crockart echoed similar complaints, citing extended wait times and inefficiencies during the transition. One traveler, Jourdan McC, tweeted: 'Been going on for a few weeks now. Total disaster! Has convinced me back to trains.' A photo shared online last month showed a queue stretching over 100 yards, captioned: 'Edinburgh Airport enters “longest security queue” contest.' A Skytrax review from November 14 described a passenger missing a flight despite arriving over an hour early. The new security hall is 1.5 times larger than the old one and includes facial recognition technology and upgraded hand luggage scanners. Edinburgh Airport officials maintain that the delays are temporary and part of a necessary transition, with full operations expected soon. John Watson, Chief Commercial Officer, acknowledged 'technical teething issues' but emphasized the long-term benefits and thanked passengers for their patience.

article_content: By Olivia Williams. PUBLISHED: 11:09 EST, 15 July 2013. | UPDATED: 02:28 EST, 16 July 2013. This is the first glimpse of Rolls-Royce’s £250,000 supercar — the Wraith. The brand-new model was spotted on a suburban street in Hampshire as one of the company’s engineers tested it ahead of its official sale. Photographs emerged before the car’s public debut at the Goodwood Festival of Speed in West Sussex over the weekend. The Rolls-Royce Wraith made an unlikely appearance on a quiet street in Hayling Island, Hampshire, captured by local resident Zac Austin. The car, set to go on sale in October for £250,000, accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in just 4.4 seconds. Though Rolls-Royce declines to disclose its waiting list, the company describes the profile of prospective buyers as 'eclectic.' The name 'Wraith' — derived from the Scottish word for 'apparition' or 'ghost' — suggests the model is designed to appeal to a younger, more dynamic segment than Rolls-Royce’s traditionally stately clientele. Current owners include David Beckham, Christina Aguilera, Simon Cowell, and Sir Alan Sugar. With bespoke options such as a roof lining embedded with 1,340 tiny LED lights to mimic the night sky, the Wraith is expected to attract high-profile clients, including professional footballers seeking the ultimate status symbol. Power comes from a 624bhp, 590lb-ft V12 engine, generating strong anticipation among car enthusiasts. Additional features include voice-activated controls, adaptive headlights, and a keyless trunk release. At the Goodwood Festival of Speed, the Wraith made its official debut, completing the 1.16-mile hill climb in under 60 seconds and reaching speeds of 134 mph as it passed Goodwood House. Business Secretary Vince Cable took the opportunity to sit in the vehicle during the event — though only while it was stationary.

article_content: Feeling hungry inside an airport rarely has a happy ending. The choice often comes down to a soggy sandwich—or another soggy sandwich. If you wait until your flight to eat, you might end up with an even soggier one. But it doesn’t have to be this way. In recent years, airports worldwide have transformed into culinary hubs as chefs recognize the opportunity: captive travelers with time to spare, empty stomachs, and wallets ready to open. To highlight this shift, Condé Nast Traveler published its first-ever list of the world’s best airport restaurants and dishes in its October 2014 issue. The panel included Michelin-starred chefs such as Daniel Boulud, Grant Achatz, Richard Blais, and Jamie Bissonnette. At New York’s JFK Airport, Palm Bar & Grille offers the Bozzi burger—with aged Gouda, smoky barbecue sauce, and crispy fried onions. In Chicago’s O’Hare Airport, Rick Bayless’ Tortas Frontera stands out for its short rib tortas, smoked pork molletes, fresh salads, and house-made margaritas. Chef Michael Chernow called it 'the best airport food I’ve had to date,' while Anita Lo said it 'delivers on the chef’s reputation.' London’s Heathrow Terminal features three top picks: Carluccio’s for its excellent eggs and coffee, Gordon Ramsay’s Plane Food for its butter chicken curry with fried chickpea rice, and Caviar House & Prunier Seafood Bar for its premium caviar and champagne. San Francisco International Airport leads with five entries: Fung Lum, Cat Cora’s Kitchen, Yankee Pier, Ebisu, and Lark Creek. Tokyo’s Narita Airport boasts Sushi Kyotatsu, where the fish is 'beyond superb,' the views of departing planes are stunning, and lines stretch down the corridor. Chef Chris Cosentino described it as 'a perfect farewell to Japan.' In Venice’s Marco Polo Airport, Rustichelli & Mangione’s mozzarella pomodoro pane tostato is widely praised. At Dubai International Airport, Cádiz Tapas offers authentic Spanish small plates and South American wines—a great spot to unwind with a glass of wine near Gate B26 in Terminal 3. Other highlights include Metro Pizza at Las Vegas’s McCarran Airport—Jon Gray, VP of Linq, swears by its classic pepperoni slice—and Legal Sea Foods in Boston Logan, recommended by Jamie Bissonnette for breakfast and a Bloody Mary. Additional standout spots include Yazoo Brewing Company (Nashville), Matsutake Sushi (Washington Dulles), La Carreta (Miami), Bisoux Custom Burgers (LaGuardia), Kampong Cafe (Singapore Changi), Casa do Pão de Queijo (Rio and São Paulo), Maxim’s (Hong Kong), Colosseum (Rome Fiumicino), Ad Coffee (Cam Ranh, Vietnam), and Miracle Food Village (Bangkok Suvarnabhumi).

Aby zdôraznili túto zmenu, Condé Nast Traveler vyrobil svoj prvý zoznam najlepších letiskových reštaurácií a jedál vo svojom vydaniu z októbra 2014. Zoznam tvorili šéfchi s Michelinovou hviezdičkou, vrátane Daniela Bouluda, Granta Achatza, Richarda Blaisa a Jamieho Bissonnetta. Na letisku JFK v New Yorku ponúka Palm Bar & Grille burger Bozzi s vyzretým Goudou, kúreným barbeque omáčkou a korenenými prženými cibulkami. Na letisku O’Hare v Chicagu sa vyníma Tortas Frontera Ricka Baylessa svojimi tortami zo zváraného bravčového rebra, kúreným bravčovým molletom, čerstvými salátmi a domáceho výroby margaritami. Šéf Michael Chernow ho nazval 'najlepšou letiskovou jedlou, ktorú som kedy mal,' a Anita Lo povedala, že 'splňuje očakávania podľa mena šéfa.' Letisko Heathrow v Londýne má tri najlepšie volby: Carluccio’s pre skvelé vajcia a kávu, Gordon Ramsay’s Plane Food pre kurčaťa v maslíkovom karame a prženú ryžu z čočky a Caviar House & Prunier Seafood Bar pre dômyselný kaviár a šampaně. Medzinárodné letisko San Francisco vedie so šiestimi záznamami: Fung Lum, Cat Cora’s Kitchen, Yankee Pier, Ebisu a Lark Creek. Medzinárodné letisko Narita v Tokiu má Sushi Kyotatsu, kde je ryba 'mimo bežného', pohľad na odlietajúce lietadlá je úžasný a rady sa tiahnu po chodbe. Šéf Chris Cosentino to popísal ako 'perfektný rozlúčku s Japonskom.' V letisku Marco Polo vo Venezii je mozzarella pomodoro pane tostato od Rustichelli & Mangione veľmi cenene. Na Medzinárodnom letisku Dubai ponúka Cádiz Tapas autentické španielske malé jedlá a juhoamerické vína — ideálne miesto na uvoľnenie s pohárikom vína pri bráne B26 v termináli 3. Ďalšími významnými miestami sú Metro Pizza na letisku McCarran v Las Vegas — Jon Gray, viceprezident Linq, odporúča klasickú pizzu s peperóni — a Legal Sea Foods v Boston Logan, odporúčané Jamiem Bissonnettom na raňajky a Bloody Mary. Ďalšie významné miesta zahŕňajú Yazoo Brewing Company (Nashville), Matsutake Sushi (Washington Dulles), La Carreta (Miami), Bisoux Custom Burgers (LaGuardia), Kampong Cafe (Singapur Changi), Casa do Pão de Queijo (Rio a São Paulo), Maxim’s (Hongkong), Colosseum (Rím Fiumicino), Ad Coffee (Cam Ranh, Vietnam) a Miracle Food Village (Bangkok Suvarnabhumi).

article_content: ETtech: From left: Lalit Vijay and Meghna Saraogi, co-founders of mirrAR, an augmented reality (AR) platform for fashion brands, announced that it has raised ₹13 crore in a funding round led by US-based IT services company Diaspark and India Angel Network (IAN). Several angel investors also participated, including Vineeta Singh and Kaushik Mukherjee, co-founders of Sugar Cosmetics; Khadim Batti, CEO and co-founder of Whatfix; Ashish Tulsian, co-founder and CEO of Posist; Umang Bedi, co-founder of Dailyhunt; Aparna Chennapragada, CVP at Microsoft; Dipak Gupta, MD at Kotak Mahindra Bank; Shanti Ekambaram, whole-time director at Kotak Mahindra Bank; and Alagu Periyannan, founder of BlueJeans by Verizon. The company aims to use the funding to capture the global fashion retail market and scale its operations—with a particular focus on the beauty and wellness industry. Founded by Meghna Saraogi and Lalit Vijay, mirrAR.com is a portfolio company of Saraogi’s first venture, StyleDotMe. It provides brands with AR technology to deliver 3D and 360-degree shopping experiences on their websites. Its beauty-focused product allows customers to virtually try on lipsticks, eyeliners, blushes, and other cosmetics before purchasing. "While we're constantly innovating for the jewelry industry, we're very excited about expanding into beauty and wellness," said Saraogi, who is also CEO of mirrAR. "Customers today are more informed and expect consistent innovation from brands. With our AR and AI technology, we're delivering personalized, pre-visualized makeup experiences globally to meet these evolving expectations," she added. Previously, mirrAR raised ₹10 crore from investors including Rajan Anandan of PeakXV Partners and Ritesh Malik, founder of Innov8. The company, which currently employs 30 people, serves over 50 clients—including Tanishq Jewellery, Forevermark, and Titan. "mirrAR is revolutionizing digital commerce through AR. I believe their technology is transforming fashion and beauty retail," said Vineeta Singh, co-founder and CEO of Sugar Cosmetics, who participated in this round.

article_content: By Emma Reynolds. PUBLISHED: 10:31 EST, 21 May 2012. | UPDATED: 11:11 EST, 21 May 2012. Fateful night: Evan Dube, 19, was at a beach barbecue in Lerwick when he went for a swim shortly after 9 p.m. A U.S. student working on an archaeological project in the Shetland Islands collapsed and died after an evening swim. Evan Dube, a first-year student at Bates College in Lewiston, Maine, was participating in a group barbecue with ten fellow students when he entered the sea around 9 p.m. Police said: 'Evan went into the water and, upon returning to shore, appeared to collapse.' An ambulance arrived within minutes, and he was airlifted to a nearby hospital. Despite resuscitation efforts, he could not be revived. An autopsy is being conducted. The teenager, from Plaistow, New Hampshire, was involved in the Shetland Islands Climate and Settlement Project — a collaborative study examining how extreme climate shifts affected ancient human settlements, particularly in Quendale Valley, where a community was buried by sandstorms and abandoned between 1690 and 1710 AD. Bates College released a statement: 'We are shaken and deeply saddened to learn that first-year student Evan Dube died on Saturday night, May 19, in the Shetland Islands, Scotland. At this time, we have no further details about the incident — only that we have lost a member of our community far too soon.' 'Evan’s fellow students in Scotland are receiving grief counseling and will return to Boston on Tuesday.' The college described Dube, a Buddhist, as 'a serious, exuberant, and caring friend.' Dean of Students Tedd Goundie wrote in an email to the student body: 'We will be processing this terrible loss for many days — and long into the future. Please join me in keeping Evan’s family and friends in your thoughts and prayers.'

article_content: By Ian Parkes, Press Association. Daniel Ricciardo believes finishing ahead of Sebastian Vettel in this year's Formula One world championship would be a real feather in his cap. Back-to-back third-place finishes in the last two Grands Prix — behind the dominant Mercedes duo of Lewis Hamilton and Nico Rosberg — have lifted Red Bull's Ricciardo into fourth place in the drivers' standings. Reigning four-time champion Vettel has struggled with reliability issues this season and now sits nine points behind Ricciardo, who was promoted from Toro Rosso at the end of last season to replace Mark Webber. Despite major regulation changes over the winter, few expected the 24-year-old Australian to outperform Vettel so early in the season — yet that is precisely what has happened. Naturally, Ricciardo is aware of the prestige he would gain if he remains ahead of Vettel by the season finale in Abu Dhabi. 'It wouldn't be a bad thing. It would give me a lot of confidence,' Ricciardo said ahead of this weekend's Canadian Grand Prix, which Vettel won 12 months ago. 'In saying that, I've probably already done enough to show the guys I can do it — not necessarily beat Seb, but race at the front, be in a top team, and deserve to be here. Whatever happens in the championship, unless we win, the final result probably won't matter. They'll look back at specific races and say, 'In this one he did well,' or 'In this one he did quite well.' It would be a nice pat on the back, I guess.' Bearing in mind that Vettel has never finished behind a teammate since entering F1 in 2007, Ricciardo insists there's no magic to his success — just unwavering self-belief. 'It's important for me to learn from him — I'd be foolish not to, because he's clearly the best in the world. But I also work best when I focus on myself. If I get distracted by what Seb is doing, it takes my focus away from what I need to do,' Ricciardo added. 'I have a lot of belief in my ability. If I do everything I can to the best of my ability, the results will follow. Right now, 95% of my focus is on myself. If I can pick up a little from Seb along the way, great — but first, I stick to what I know, then worry about the rest later.'

Daniel Ricciardo verí, že dokončiť pred Sebastianom Vettelom v tomto ročníku majstrovstiev sveta vo Formule 1 by bolo pre neho skutočným perom v čiapke. Dva po sebe idúce tretie miesta v posledných dvoch veľkých cenách — za dominujúcimi pilotmi Mercedes Lewisom Hamiltonom a Nico Rosbergom — zvýšili Ricciarda z Red Bullu na štvrté miesto v klasifikácii jazdcov. Titulovaný štvornásobný majster Vettel tento rok trpel problémami s spoľahlivosťou a teraz je za Ricciardom o deväť bodov. Ricciardo bol prepustený z Toro Rosso na konci minulého roka ako náhrada za Marka Webbera. Napriek veľkým zmenám pravidiel počas zimy si málo kto dal peniaze na to, aby 24-ročný Austrálčan tak rýchlo prevzal náskok nad Vettelom — no práve to sa stalo. Ricciardo si je samozrejme vedomý prestíže, ktorú by získal, keby zostal pred Vettelom až do konca sezóny v Abu Dhabi. 'Nebylo by to zlé. Dalo by mi to veľa sebavedomia,' povedal Ricciardo pred víkendovou veľkou cenou Kanady, ktorú Vettel vyhral pred rokom. 'Pritom som už asi urobil dostatočne veľa, aby som ukázal chlapcom, že to viem — nie nutne poraziť Seba, ale bojovať na vrchole, byť v tíme na najvyššej úrovni a zaslúžiť si byť tu. Čo sa stane v majstrovstvách, výsledok — ak nevyhrajeme, pravdepodobne nebude mať význam. Pozrú sa na konkrétne preteky v sezóne a povedajú: 'V tomto sa darilo', alebo 'V tomto sa mu darilo dosť'. Bolo by to pekné potlesknutie, myslím.' Vzhľadom na to, že Vettel nikdy nekončil za kolegom od svojho vstupu do F1 v roku 2007, Ricciardo trvá, že v jeho dosiahnutom výsledku nie je žiadna kúzelná sila — len nekmitajúca sebavedomie. 'Je dôležité, aby som sa od neho (Vettela) učil — bolo by hlúpe to ignorovať, pretože je jasné, že je najlepší na svete. Ale zároveň pracujem najlepšie, keď sa sústredím na seba. Ak sa zbytočne rozptylujem tým, čo robí Seb, stratím zameranie na to, čo musím robiť,' pripočítal Ricciardo. 'Mám veľa vieru vo svoje schopnosti. Ak urobím všetko, čo môžem, aby som urobil čo najlepšie, výsledky prídu. Momentálne je 95 % mojej pozornosti zamerané na mňa, a ak sa môžem z Vettela niečo naučiť, tak áno — ale najprv robím to, čo viem, a potom sa zaoberám ostatným.'

article_content: A married couple from Oregon, Sarah Mangus, 29, and Jamie Mangus, 34, have been charged with murder and first-degree manslaughter in connection with the death of their newborn daughter, Krystal. The charges stem from events on April 12, when Krystal died just hours after birth. According to the Oregon State Medical Examiner’s Office, the infant’s cause of death was methamphetamine intoxication and neonatal pneumonia—likely resulting from prenatal exposure to the drug via the placenta. Emergency responders were called to a Portland home after reports that the baby was not breathing. Police determined that Krystal had been born approximately 12 hours earlier at a different location in North Portland and had received no medical attention. The case was presented to a grand jury last week, and the couple was arrested on Friday morning. They were arraigned on Monday and pleaded not guilty. Their trial is scheduled for August 26. Sarah Mangus’s mother, Marie Dakota, has publicly blamed the local hospital for Krystal’s death. In an interview with Fox12, she stated that her daughter did everything possible to care for the newborn: cleaning her, dressing her, and properly clamping the umbilical cord. She added that the baby had good color, cried, and sucked from a bottle. 'So, I don’t agree with any of this,' Dakota said.
translated_content: Manželský pár z Oregónu, Sarah Mangus, 29, a Jamie Mangus, 34, boli obvinení z vraždy a nezákonnej ublíženia na zdraví prvej stupne v súvislosti so smrťou ich novorodenej dcéry Krystal. Obvinenie sa týka udalostí z 12. apríla, keď Krystal zomrela niekoľko hodín po narodení. Podľa Úradu štátneho patológa v Oregone bola príčinou úmrtia dieťaťa intoksikácia metamfetamínom a novorodenecká pneumónia – pravdepodobne spôsobená prednárodovou expozíciou na túto látku cez placentu. Záchranné tímy boli volané na dom v Portlande po nahlásení, že dieťa nebude dýchať. Polícia zistila, že Krystal bola narodená približne 12 hodín predtým na inej lokalite v severnom Portlande a nezískala žiadnu lekársku starostlivosť. Prípad bol predložený veľkému porotcovi minulý týždeň a pár bol zatknutý v piatok ráno. Boli predvedení súdu v pondelok a vyhlásili nevinnosť. Ich súdny proces je naplánovaný na 26. august. Matka Sarah Mangus, Marie Dakota, verejne obviňuje miestnu nemocnicu zo smrti Krystal. V rozhovore s Fox12 povedala, že jej dcéra urobila všetko, čo mohla, aby sa o novorodenca postarala: vyčistila ho, oblekla ho a správne zatiahla pupočnú šnúru. Pridala, že dieťa malo dobrú farbu, plakalo a sa pije z fľaše. „Takže sa s tým nesúhlasím,“ povedala Dakota.

article_content: If you're looking to refresh your smartphone’s home screen, Facebook has something new in store: Paper, a sleek news reader designed to turn scrolling through updates into a more thoughtful, visual experience. Launching February 3 for iPhone users in the U.S., Paper isn’t meant to replace the main Facebook app — but rather to reimagine how you engage with the content already in your feed. Think of it as a digital magazine built around your network: long-form posts, striking photos, and videos are displayed in full-screen, minimalist layouts that eliminate clutter and distractions. The app encourages you to slow down and savor stories, whether they come from friends or curated sources like science journals, food blogs, or photography magazines. Navigation? No buttons. Just tilt your phone to browse or swipe to turn pages — it feels more like flipping through a physical publication than tapping icons. You can personalize your feed with over a dozen topics, from sports to design, pulling in both independent creators and trusted publishers. Before sharing your own content, Paper lets you preview it first, giving you control over how your story looks. This is the debut project from Facebook Creative Labs, a team formed to explore fresh mobile experiences beyond the core app. It’s a clear signal that Facebook, once criticized for lagging behind in mobile, now sees smartphones as central to its future. In fact, nearly all of Facebook’s 1.2 billion users access the platform via mobile devices, and mobile ads now generate more than half of its revenue — a dramatic leap from just a few years ago.
translated_content: Ak hľadáte spôsob, ako obnoviť domovskú obrazovku vášho smartfónu, Facebook má pre vás niečo nové: Paper, šikovná aplikácia na čítanie správ, ktorá má premeniť prechádzanie aktualizáciami na zvážnejší, vizuálne bohatšiu skúsenosť. Aplikácia sa uvedie 3. februára pre používateľov iPhone v USA a nie je určená na nahradenie hlavnej Facebook aplikácie, ale na preformátovanie toho, ako sa pohybujete v obsahu, ktorý už máte vo svojom prúde. Predstavte si to ako digitálny časopis postavený okolo vašej siete: dlhšie príspevky, nádherné fotografie a videá sú zobrazené v plnoobrazovkových, minimálnych rozloženiach, ktoré odstraňujú rušivé prvky. Aplikácia vás povzbudzuje, aby ste sa zastavili a užili si príbehy, či už prichádzajú od priateľov alebo kuratovaných zdrojov ako vedecké časopisy, blogy o jedle alebo fotografické portfóliá. Navigácia? Žiadne tlačidlá. Len naklonite telefón, aby ste prechádzali, alebo posuňte prstom, aby ste otvorili stránku — cíti sa to viac ako listovanie fyzickou publikáciou než klikanie na ikony. Môžete si prispôsobiť svoj prúd cez viac ako dvanásť tém, od športu po dizajn, pričom sa zobrazujú aj nezávislí tvorcovia a spoľahlivé publikácie. Pred zdieľaním vlastného obsahu vám Paper umožní náhľad, aby ste mali kontrolu nad tým, ako váš príbeh vyzerá. Toto je prvý projekt Facebook Creative Labs, tímu vytvoreného na hľadanie nových mobilných skúseností mimo jadrovú aplikáciu. Je to jasný signál, že Facebook, ktorý bol kedysi kritizovaný za oneskorenie v mobilnom trhu, teraz vidí chytré telefóny ako stredisko svojej budúcnosti. V skutočnosti, takmer všetci 1,2 miliardy používateľov Facebooku prístup majú cez mobilné zariadenia a mobilné reklamy teraz generujú viac ako polovicu príjmov — dramatický skok oproti niekoľkým rokom nazad.

article_content: A UK High Court judge has ruled that severe restrictions placed on a 24-year-old Somali national, known as CF, must be eased to allow him more ordinary social interaction as a university student. Although CF is under a Terrorism Prevention and Investigation Measure (TPIM) — a legal tool designed to limit movement, technology use, and associations of suspected terrorists — the judge found that prohibiting all non-academic contact with peers was unnecessarily harsh and psychologically damaging. Mr Justice Wilkie argued that such isolation served no clear purpose in enhancing national security, especially since informal encounters during lectures or in libraries are unavoidable. The ruling, which requires the Home Office to revise the conditions, has sparked debate over whether the courts are prioritizing individual rights over public safety. Security officials continue to warn that CF may seek to reconnect with extremist networks, though he has never been convicted of any terrorist act. The judge did not grant CF’s request to shorten his curfew or own an MP3 player. Meanwhile, CF had previously breached a ban on visiting the Olympic Park in Stratford, but authorities chose not to prosecute. Conservative MP Patrick Mercer criticized the decision, stating that CF’s limited social life is a consequence of his own choices to associate with militant groups abroad, and that public safety should remain the top priority.

Hoci CF je pod Tímovými opatreniami na prevenciu terorizmu (TPIM) — právnym nástrojom určeným na obmedzenie pohybu, používania technológií a kontaktov podozrivých z terorizmu — sudca považoval za neprimerane prísne zakázanie všetkého mimoučebného kontaktu so spoluštudentmi. Súdca Mr Justice Wilkie tvrdil, že takáto izolácia nemá žiadny jasný účinok na posilnenie národnej bezpečnosti, najmä keď neformálne stretnutia počas prednášok alebo v knižnici sú nevyhnutné. Toto rozhodnutie, ktoré vyžaduje od domáceho úradu revíziu podmienok, vyvolalo diskusiu o tom, či súdy uprednostňujú individuálne práva pred verejnou bezpečnosťou. Bezpečnostné orgány varujú, že CF sa môže pokúsiť znovu naviazať kontakt s extrémistickými sieťami, aj keď nikdy nebol odsúdený za akýkoľvek teroristický čin. Sudca nevyhovel CF-ovi vo vyžiadanií skrátenia nocného výstupu alebo vlastnenia MP3 prehrávača. CF predtým porušil zákaz návštevy Olympijského parku v Stratforde, ale úrady sa rozhodli ho neprestupovať. Konzervatívny poslanec Patrick Mercer kritizoval rozhodnutie, povedal, že CF-ova obmedzená sociálna životnosť je dôsledkom jeho vlastných volieb spájať sa s bojovníckymi skupinami v zahraničí a že verejná bezpečnosť by mala zostať najvyššou prioritou.

article_content: Bayern Munich enters the Bundesliga winter break with a three-point advantage after a strong weekend of fixtures. Despite Franck Ribery’s red card in their 3-0 win over Cologne on Friday, Bayern remained atop the table. On Saturday, title rivals Borussia Dortmund and Schalke delivered commanding performances to keep the pressure on. Dortmund crushed Freiburg 4-1, with Robert Lewandowski scoring twice to reach 13 league goals this season. Shinji Kagawa and Kevin Großkreutz played pivotal roles in setting up Lewandowski’s goals. Schalke matched Dortmund’s result with a stunning 5-0 thrashing of Werder Bremen, led by veteran striker Raul, who netted a hat-trick — his third hat-trick for the club since joining from Real Madrid in 2010. Klaas-Jan Huntelaar contributed two assists and a goal, while Kyriakos Papadopoulos and Huntelaar added further strikes. Fourth-placed Borussia Mönchengladbach sits just one point behind, aiming to close the gap when they host Mainz on Sunday. Meanwhile, Bayer Leverkusen’s title hopes took a hit after a 3-0 home loss to Nuremberg, whose goals came from Daniel Didavi, Jan Hegler, and Tomas Pekhart. Hamburg climbed above Mainz after a 1-1 draw with Augsburg, extending coach Thorsten Fink’s unbeaten run to nine matches. Torsten Oehrl gave Augsburg the lead, but Paolo Guerrero equalized shortly after. Wolfsburg moved into 12th place with a 1-0 win over Stuttgart, thanks to Sebastian Polter’s 74th-minute goal on his second league appearance. In a fiery mid-table clash, Hoffenheim and Hertha Berlin drew 1-1 after both teams were reduced to 10 men. Sejad Salihovic gave Hoffenheim the lead, but Raffael and Isaac Vorsah were sent off, and Roman Hubnik equalized deep into stoppage time. Freiburg now sits bottom of the table after being overtaken on goal difference by Augsburg.

article_content: Stephen Carter, a 53-year-old firefighter from the UK, was tired of avoiding smiles due to decades of neglected dental health. Years of sugary drinks and dental anxiety had left his teeth in ruins. When he needed full-mouth implants, the UK price tag—between £16,000 and £21,000—felt impossible. So he turned to Budapest, where a clinic promised affordable implants, free lodging, and even a £500 discount for paying cash. He spent £6,500 upfront for a fixed palate with a lifetime guarantee, confident he’d found a solution. The procedure went smoothly—the teeth looked perfect, and he smiled again. But three months later, biting into a Mars bar shattered one of his new teeth. He reached out to the clinic and received a replacement. Then another tooth fell out. Then another. Within weeks, the entire dental bridge collapsed. Despite the 'lifetime guarantee,' the clinic insisted he return to Hungary at his own expense—and pay again for repairs. After two grueling years of broken teeth and empty pockets, he’d lost over £10,000 and received only a quarter of his money back. His confidence vanished. He stopped laughing out loud, avoided photos, and felt trapped by his own mouth. Everything changed when he appeared on Channel 5’s 'Botched Up Bodies: Abroad'. Cosmetic surgeon Dr. Adam Slade stepped in, rebuilt his jaw with precision, and gave him functional, natural-looking teeth. Now, Stephen grins freely, eats without fear, and says he feels like himself again. Experts warn his story isn’t rare. Surgeons like Patrick Mallucci say the UK is seeing a surge in patients damaged by poorly regulated cosmetic procedures abroad—where low prices often mask dangerous compromises.

Zaplatil 6 500 libier na predplatenie fixnej palatiny s životnou zárukou, veril, že našiel riešenie. Postup prebehol hladko — zuby vyzerali dokonale a znova sa usmieval. Ale tri mesiace neskôr, keď zjedol čokoládu Mars, sa jeden z jeho nových zubov rozbil. Kontaktoval kliniku a dostal náhradný zub. Potom padol ďalší. A potom ešte jeden. Po týždňoch sa celý mostík zubov pokazil. Aj napriek „životnej záruke“ klinika trvala na tom, aby sa vrátil do Maďarska na vlastné náklady — a znova zaplatil za opravu. Po dvoch únavných rokoch poškodených zubov a prázdnych peňaženiek stratil viac ako 10 000 libier a dostal iba štvrtinu svojich peňazí späť. Jeho sebavedomie zmizlo. Prestal sa smieť nahlas, vyhýbal sa fotkám a cítil sa zajatý vlastnou ústami. Všetko sa zmenilo, keď sa objavil v relácii Channel 5 'Botched Up Bodies: Abroad'. Estetický chirurg Dr. Adam Slade mu pomohol, znovu postavil jeho čeľusť presne a dal mu funkčné, prirodzené zuby. Teraz Stephen bez obav úsmevom, jedá bez strachu a hovorí, že sa znova cíti ako on sám. Odborníci varujú, že jeho príbeh nie je vzácny. article_content: Eva Walusimbi understands firsthand the toll of living without electricity. As a community leader in Mityana, central Uganda, she has witnessed the health dangers and economic struggles faced by families in rural areas cut off from the power grid. 'Just three miles away, villagers rely on candles or kerosene lamps,' says Walusimbi, who runs schools for orphans and vulnerable children. 'One morning, a girl was pulled out of school early — her sibling had died in a fire. She’d left a candle burning while stepping outside, and by the time she returned, the house was engulfed. The child was lost to the flames.' According to the World Bank, roughly 90% of Ugandans live without electricity. Beyond the immediate risks, Walusimbi, 50, says the absence of light stifles economic opportunity. 'Without power, their days end at sunset. They can’t work, study, or earn like those with reliable lighting.' But for Walusimbi, there’s hope. She’s joined Solar Sister, an initiative that combats energy poverty by training and supporting women entrepreneurs to sell affordable solar lamps and phone chargers across East Africa. Using a direct-sales model similar to Avon, these women leverage personal networks to build sustainable businesses, earning commissions on every sale. Founded by Katherine Lucey, a former energy-sector investment banker from Rhode Island, Solar Sister believes that access to clean energy isn’t just about light — it’s about dignity and economic mobility. 'This gives women steady, controllable income — money they can invest in their children’s education,' Lucey says. 'You can’t rise above subsistence without energy. With it, entire families transform.' Globally, 589 million Africans lack grid access, and off-grid households spend $4.4 billion annually on kerosene — a costly, toxic, and dangerous fuel. Lucey argues that philanthropy alone won’t solve this crisis. 'A third of the world lacks electricity. It won’t be fixed by donations. It needs a market — where people buy what they need, when they need it.' More than 270 women in Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan now run Solar Sister businesses. The organization focuses exclusively on women because they are typically the ones managing household energy — walking miles for firewood, buying kerosene, and making daily safety decisions. 'If we want real change, we must empower the decision-makers,' Lucey explains. Back in Mityana, Walusimbi says her life has changed dramatically. 'I’m no longer begging for help. I’m earning — and that brings me pride. When I can provide for my family, I feel whole.'
translated_content: Eva Walusimbi zná na vlastnej koži, aké je žiť v temnote. Ako spoločenská líderness v malom meste Mityana v strede Ugandy videla zdravotné riziká a finančné ťažkosti, ktoré nedostatok elektriny prináša rodinám v chudobných, vidieckych oblastiach. 'Len tri míle odtiaľ ľudia v dedinách nemajú elektrinu — niektorí používajú sviečky, iní petrolejové lampy,' hovorí Walusimbi, ktorá vedie školy pre siroty a znevýhodnené deti v Ugande. 'Jedného rána bola dievča vybrané zo školy skôr, lebo jej súrodenec zahynul v požari. Zapálila sviečku v dome, potom vyšla von urobiť iné práce, sviečka sa roztopila a dom bol celý v plameniach. Keď sa vrátili, aby zistili, čo sa deje, dom bol úplne spálený a dievča bolo spálené na popol.' Podľa údajov Svetovej banky okolo 90 % obyvateľov Ugandy žije bez prístupu k elektrine. Okrem zdravotných rizík, hovorí 50-ročná Walusimbi, že nedostatok elektriny bráni ľuďom v tom, aby sa dostali z chudoby. 'Ľudia, ktorí žijú bez elektriny, ich deň končí veľmi rýchlo — môžu urobiť menej práce ako tí, ktorí majú plné osvetlenie.' Ale pre Walusimbi je na konci tunela svetlo. Prispojila sa k organizácii Solar Sister, ktorá sa snaží zlikvidovať energetickú chudobu a zároveň vytvoriť ekonomické príležitosti pre ženy. Pomocou modelu distribúcie podobného Avonu, Solar Sister školí, rekrutuje a podporuje ženských podnikateľov v Východnej Afrike, aby predávali prístupné slnečné osvetlenie a iné ekologické produkty, ako sú slnečné lampy a nabíjače mobilných telefónov. Ženy využívajú svoje komunitné siete rodiny a susedov na budovanie vlastných podnikov a zarábajú províziu za každú predaj. Zakladateľka Solar Sister Katherine Lucey, bývalá investičná bankárka s odbornosťou v energetickom sektore, hovorí, že tento model vytvára prístup k bezpečnému, prístupnému a čistému energii a zároveň pomáha ženám získať stabilný príjem na podporu svojich rodín. 'To im dáva šancu zarábať peniaze spôsobom, ktorý je oveľa stabilnejší — majú nad nimi kontrolu a tieto peniaze môžu ísť do rodiny,' hovorí Lucey, ktorá sídli v Rhode Islande, USA. 'V skoro všetkých prípadoch vidíme, že ich používajú na vzdelávanie ich detí.' Počas svojej 20-ročnej kariéry ako energetická manažérka, povedala Lucey, že videla, ako prístup k elektrine je základný pre hospodársky rast. Ale keď pracovala na veľkých energetických projektov v rozvojových krajinách, uvedomila si, že tlačivé potreby mnohých chudobných jednotlivcov stále neboli spokojné. Po tmavej noc, domy nepripojené k elektrickej sieti sa hlavne opierajú o otvorené plamene petrolejových lánok. Také laterny však predstavujú požiarové riziká, vydávajú toxické plyny a zatiažujú rodinné rozpočty. 'Nemôžete sa vyraziť nad hranicu existencie, ak nemáte svetlo, elektrinu a energiu,' hovorí Lucey. 'A keď ju máte, je to obrovské, čo ľudia dokážu dosiahnuť a aký dopad má to na životy ľudí: deti sa môžu viac študovať a chodiť do školy, ženy môžu začať podniky a môžu sa staráť o svoje rodiny.' Podľa Lighting Africa, spoločného programu Svetoovej banky a Medzinárodnej finančnej korporácie, ktorý sa vyvíja na zvýšenie prístupu k čistým zdrojom energie pre osvetlenie, 589 miliónov ľudí na kontinente žije bez prístupu k verejnej elektrickej sieti. Skupina hovorí, že chudobné vidiecke domácnosti a malé podniky v Afrike platia 10 miliárd dolárov ročne za osvetlenie, kým komunity nepripojené k sieti strávia 4,4 miliardy dolárov ročne na petrolej. Lucey hovorí, že ukončenie kultúry závislosti od pomoci je kľúčové na pomoc ľuďom vyskakovať z hospodárskej ťažkosti a riešiť problém energetickej chudoby. 'Na svete nie je dostatok filantropie, aby vyriešil tento problém,' hovorí. 'Tretina svetovej populácie nemá prístup k elektrine — nebude vyriešená filantropiou, bude vyriešená nejakým trhovým mechanizmom, kde ľudia majú prístup k tomuto produktu... a kupujú ho, keď ho potrebujú.' Do dnešného dňa sa k Solar Sister prihlásilo viac ako 270 podnikateľov v Ugande, Rwande a Južnom Sudáne. Lucey hovorí, že skupina, ktorá sa chce rozšíriť aj do iných krajín kontinentu, sa sústredí výlučne na ženy, pretože sú zodpovedné za riadenie energetických potrieb domácnosti. 'Ženy sú tými, ktoré prechádzajú míle, aby orezávali drevo; ženy sú tými, ktoré idú na trh, aby kúpili petrolej — takže ak sme chceli urobiť zmenu, ktorú by niekto povedal „no, prestanem používať petrolej, kúpim slnečnú lampu a používam čistejšiu technológiu“, muselo to byť osoba, ktorá bola zodpovedná za rozhodnutie — a to sú ženy.' Späť v Mityane, Walusimbi hovorí, že jej život sa 'zmenil obrovsko', keď začala pracovať s touto skupinou, používajúc extra peniaze na pokrytie domácnosti a poľnohospodárskych potrieb. 'Cítim sa hrdá, že prinášam príjem do môjho domáceho hospodárstva,' hovorí. 'Pretože ak môžem podporiť svoju rodinu, cítim sa dobre — namiesto bezmocného prosenia a hľadania všetkého, aby bolo sponzorované.'
